source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.

hypothesis: Pagi ini, Sara Danius, sekretaris tetap Komite Nobel gasan Sastra di Swedish Academy, mengumumkan secara terbuka selama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia bahwa komite, kada kawa mancapai Bob Dylan langsung tentang memenangkan Hadiah Nobel dalam Sastra 2016, telah meninggalkan usahanya gasan mancapai sidin.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."

hypothesis: Danius ujar, "Kini kami kada bagawi apa-apa. Aku sudah manunggal wan manuruih email ka kolaburannya nang paling parak wan manarima jawaban nang ramah banar.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.

source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
reference: Partunjukan ngini asalnya mangutamakan pangisi suara amatir, panduduk satampat sampai ka Texas Timur.
hypothesis: Pameran itu awalnya menampilkan aktor suara amatir, lokal ke Texas Timur.

source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
reference: Panjarahan maluas tarus balanjut sapanjang malam, Kadada patugas panagak hukum nang barada di jalan Bishkek.
hypothesis: Pelangsuran luas dilaporkan dilanjutkan di malam hari, karena petugas penegakan hukum kada hadir di jalanan Bishkek.

source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
reference: Bishkek digambarakan ulih saurang pamarhati kaya masuk ka dalam kaadaan "anarkis", nang mana sagurumbulan urang bakaliaran di jalanan wan marampas barang-barang.
hypothesis: Bishkek digambarakan sabagai "anarki" oleh sabuting pengamat, pas geng urang-urang bajalan di jalanan dan merampok toko barang konsumsi.

source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
reference: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahakan pandemo matan salatan atas palanggaran hukum.
hypothesis: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahkan pamunjuk rasa matan selatan gasan kadada hukum.

source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
reference: Afrika Salatan mangalahakan All Blacks (Islandia Baru) dalam partandingan rugby Tiga Nagara di Stadiun Royal Bafokeng, Rustenburg, Afrika Salatan.
hypothesis: Afrika Selatan sudah mengalahkan All Blacks (New Zealand) dalam pertandingan rugby union Tri Nations di Royal Bafokeng Stadium di Rustenburg, Afrika Selatan.

source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
reference: Hasil akhirnya kamanangan satu angka, 21-20, ma’akhiri kamanangan 15 kali baruntunnya All Blacks.
hypothesis: Hasil akhir adalah kemenangan satu poin, 21 lawan 20, mengakhiri rangkaian kemenangan 15 pertandingan All Blacks.

source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
reference: Gasan Springboks, ngini tu ma’akhiri kakalahan lima kali baruntun buhannya.
hypothesis: gasan Springboks, itu manuntungakan 5 laga kalah.

source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
reference: Pinal gasan All Blacks nang sudah mamanangakan piala dua minggu nang lalu.
hypothesis: Itu adalah pertandingan akhir gasan All Blacks, nang sudah menang trofi dua minggu lalu.

source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
reference: Partandingan pinal cagar batampat di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu kaina, pas Springboks malawan Australia.
hypothesis: Pertandingan akhir seri akan berlangsung di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu depan, pas Springboks lawan Australia.

source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
reference: Gampa bumi sadang mangguncang daerah barat Montana jam 10.08 Senin malam.
hypothesis: Gugur bumi nang ringan manggugur di Montana barat pas pukul 10.08 malam hari Senin.

source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
reference: Kadada habar awal karusakan nang ditarima matan Lembaga Geologi Amerika Serikat (USGS) wan Pusat Informasi Gampa Bumi Nasiunal.
hypothesis: Kadada laporan langsung tentang karusakan nang ditarima oleh United States Geological Survey (USGS) wan Pusat Informasi Gempa Nasionalnya.

source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
reference: Gampa bapusat sakitar 20 km (15 mil) utara-timur laut Dillon wan 65 km (40 mil) utara Butte.
hypothesis: Guncangan bumi itu di pusat sekitar 20 km (15 mil) utara-barat utara Dillon, dan sekitar 65 km (40 mil) selatan Butte.

source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
reference: Jenis flu burung mamatikan gasan manusia, H5N1 sudah dipastiakan mandapati itik liar tatular mati hari Senin di tanah rawa parak Lyon di timur Prancis.
hypothesis: Stem flu burung nang mambunuh manusia, H5N1, sudah dikonfirmasi sudah maninfeksi bebek liar mati, ditamui pada hari Senin, di rawa parak Lyon di timur Perancis.

source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
reference: Prancis ngini jadi nagara ka tujuh di Parsatuan Eropa nang mangalami pirus ngini; diumpati wan Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani wan Italia.
hypothesis: Perancis adalah nagara katujuh di Uni Eropa nang menderita virus ini; imbah Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani wan Italia.

source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
reference: Dugaan kasus H5N1 di Kruasia wan Denmark masih balum kawa dipastiakan.
hypothesis: Kasus nang dicurigai H5N1 di Kroasia wan Denmark tatap kada dikonfirmasi.

source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
reference: Chamber manuntut Tuhan gasan "kamatian nang maluas, kahancuran wan paneroran tarhadap jutaan panduduk Bumi."
hypothesis: Chambers sudah manuntut Allah gasan "pembunuhan, karusakan wan terorisasi jutaan lawan jutaan panduduk Bumi".

source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
reference: Chamber nang saurang agnustik, mambantah bahuwa gugatannya "babarang" wan "siapa haja kawa manuntut siapa ja."
hypothesis: Chambers, agnostik, manjawab bahwa gugatan sidin adalah "sambil" wan "sapa haja kawa manuntut siapa haja".

source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
reference: Kisah nang ditampilakan di upera Prancis, ulih Camille Saint-Saens, marupakan seniman "nang hidupnya diatur ulih kacintaannya lawan ubat-ubatan wan Japang."
hypothesis: Kisah nang dipresentasikan dalam opera Perancis, oleh Camille Saint-Saens, adalah tentang seniman "nang hidupnya dikoteri oleh cinta lawan narkoba wan Jepang".

source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
reference: Hasilnya, bubuhan pamain maisap ganja di atas panggung wan teaternya surang mambulihakan panuntunnya umpat bagabung.
hypothesis: Akibatnya, para palaku mamasukakan ganja di panggung, wan teater itu saurang mendorong penonton gasan bergabung.

source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
reference: Mantan Katua DPR Newt Gingrich, Gubarnur Texas Rick Perry, wan angguta wanita kungris Michel Bachmannpinis di paringkat ampat, lima, wan anam barurutan.
hypothesis: Mantan Speaker House Newt Gingrich, gubernur Texas Rick Perry, wan anggota Kongres Michele Bachmann mancapai urutan kaampat, kaampat, wan kaanam, taturutnya.

source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
reference: Imbah hasilnya kaluar, Gingrich maambung Santorum, tapi ngalih bakata-kata gasan Romney, nang mangatas ngaranakan kampanye negatip nang disiarakan di Iowa malawan Gingrich.
hypothesis: Imbah hasil datang, Gingrich memuji Santorum, tapi baisi kata-kata kasar gasan Romney, di mana atas namanya iklan kampanye negatif ditayangkan di Iowa lawan Gingrich.

source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
reference: Perry manyambat inya cagaran "babulik ka Texas gasan manilai hasil partamuan malam ini, manantuakan apakah masih ada jalan kawa manarusakan", tapi imbah tu manyambat kalo inya bisa tatap lanjut wan basaing tanggal 21 Januari di Carolina Salatan.
hypothesis: Perry manunjukakan bahwa inya "akan pulang ka Texas gasan mengevaluasi hasil kaukus malam ini, manantuakan apakah ada jalan maju gasan diri ulun dalam balapan ini", tapi imbah itu inya manunjukakan bahwa inya akan tatap dalam balapan dan bajuara dalam pemilu utama Carolina Selatan 21 Januari.

source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
reference: Bachmann, nang mamanangakan Poling Ames Straw di bulan Agustus mamutusakan ma’akhiri kampanyenya.
hypothesis: Bachmann, nang menang dalam Ames Straw Poll di Agustus, mamutusakan gasan manyimpan kampanye sidin.

source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
reference: Potograper dianjur ka Pusat Kesehatan Ronald Reagen UCLA nang mana imbah tu inya maninggal.
hypothesis: Fotografer ngitu dibawa ka Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, di mana inya kamatian.

source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
reference: Inya dihabarakan baumur sakitar 20 tahunan. Dalam sambatannya, Bieber manyambat, "Biar aku kada hadir atawa talibat langsung wan kajadian nitu, aku turut baduka cita gasan kaluarga kurban."
hypothesis: Inya dilaporkan sudah tuha di umur 20 tahun. Dalam pernyataan, Bieber ujar "padahal aku kada hadir atau langsung terlibat dalam kecelakaan tragis ini, pikiran wan doa ulun bersama keluarga korban".

source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
reference: Badasarakan situs garamaan hiburan TMZ, inya mahantiakan kandaraannya di pinggir Sepulveda Boulevard wan mancuba maambil poto pulisi bamandak sabalum manyubarang jalan wan malanjutakan, maminta patugas Patroli jalan Raya California mahantiakan lalu lintas gasan maminta inya manyubarang lagi dua kali.
hypothesis: Situs berita hiburan TMZ mangarti fotografer mandaratakan kendaraannya di sisi lain Sepulveda Boulevard wan mancuba maambil gambar dari parhentian polisi sabalum maliwati jalan wan manarus, nang manjurakan petugas polisi California Highway Patrol nang maulah parhentian lalu lintas gasan manyuruh sidin pulang, dua kali.

source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
reference: Manurut pulisi, pangandara nang maranjah si tukang poto pinanya kada mungkin kana tuntutan.
hypothesis: Menurut polisi, pengemudi kendaraan nang menabrak fotografer kada mungkin menghadapi tuduhan kriminal.

source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
reference: Baya tasadia lapan belas madali haja sahari, babarapa nagara sudah kada kawa mandapatakan madali.
hypothesis: Dengan hanya 18 medali nang tersedia sehari, babarapa nagara kada kawa mancapai podium medali.

source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
reference: Diantaranya tamasuk Walanda, wan Anna Jochemsen tuntung diurutan kasambilan di kalas badiri babinian di Super-G samalam wan Finlandia wan Katja Saarinen tuntung di urutan kasapuluh di acara nang sama.
hypothesis: Keduanya termasuk Belanda, lawan Anna Jochemsen finis kedelapan di kelas berdiri wanita di Super-G kemarin, dan Finlandia lawan Katja Saarinen finis kedelapan di acara nang sama.

source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Mitchell Gourley matan Australia sudah tuntung di urutan kasawelas di kalumpuk lalakian badiri Super-G. Pasaingnya matan Ceko, Oldrich Jelinek tuntung di urutan kaanam belas di kalas lalakian baduduk Super-G.
hypothesis: Australia Mitchell Gourley mancapai urutan ka-11 dalam Super-G nang berdiri di laki-laki. Peserta Czech Oldrich Jelinek mancapai urutan ka-16 dalam Super-G nang duduk di laki-laki.

source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
reference: Arly Velasquez matan Miksiko tuntung di urutan kalima belas di kalumpuk lalakian duduk Super-G. Matan Islandia Baru, Adam Hall tuntung di urutan kasambilan di kalas lalakian badiri Super-G.
hypothesis: Arly Velasquez dari Meksiko mancapai urutan ka-15 dalam kategori Super-G nang duduk di kalangan laki-laki. Adam Hall dari Selandia Baru mancapai urutan ka-9 dalam kategori Super-G nang berdiri di kalangan laki-laki.

source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Pamain ski tunanetra Polandia Maciej Krezel wan pamandunya Anna Ogarzynska tuntung di urutan katalung walas di Super-G. Jong Seork Park matan Korea Salatan sudah tuntung di urutan kadua puluh ampat di kalumpuk lalakian duduk Super-G.
hypothesis: Skier Polandia nang cacat mata Maciej Krezel wan panuntun Anna Ogarzynska mancapai urutan katiganya di Super-G. Park Jong Seork Korea Selatan mancapai urutan dua puluh ampat di Super-G nang duduk di laki-laki.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
reference: Pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB, datang ka Haiti imbah gempa bumi 2010, ditiwasakan karana manyabarakan panyakit nang mana dimulai parak serobong tantara.
hypothesis: Pasukan penjaga perdamaian PBB, nang tiba di Haiti imbah gempa bumi 2010, dituduh bagawi lawan panyebaran penyakit nang dimulai parak kamp pasukan.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
reference: Ujar parkara, limbah matan berserobong PBB itu kada tapi dibarasihi, ma’ulah bakteri masuk ka anak sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai targanal di Haiti.
hypothesis: Manurut tuntutan hukum, limbah dari kamp PBB kada disaringakan nang baik, nang manyababakan bakteri masuk ka sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai terbesar di Haiti.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sabalum kadatangan tantara, nagara Haiti kada suah bamasalah nang bahubungan panyakit itu tumatan 1800an.
hypothesis: Sabalum datang pasukan, Haiti kada tahadap masalah nang bahubungan lawan penyakit ini sajak 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
reference: Institut Haiti sagan Keadilan wan Demokrasi babulik ka kapada panalitian indipinden nang manyatakan bahuwa batalyon pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB dari Nepal kada sadar mambawa panyakit nitu ka Haiti.
hypothesis: Institut Keadilan dan Demokrasi Haiti sudah maulah rujukan ka studi independen nang manunjukakan batalion penjaga perdamaian PBB Nepal kada sadar mambawa penyakit ka Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
reference: Danielle Lantagne, saurang ahli panyakit dari PBB, manyambat bahuwa panyakit ini manyabar karna pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB.
hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ahli PBB tentang penyakit ini, ujar bahwa wabah ini mungkin disebabkan oleh pasukan perdamaian.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
reference: Hamiton mamastiakan Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard manarima amun pasien ngitu dalam kondisi nang stabil.
hypothesis: Hamilton man konfirmasi Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard manarima pasien dalam kondisi stabil.

source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
reference: Pasien itu sudah ka Nigeria, nang mana babarapa kasus Ebola sudah tajadi.
hypothesis: Pasien itu sudah di Nigeria, di mana ada beberapa kasus virus Ebola.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
reference: Rumah Sakit sudah maumpati protokol gasan manguntrul infeksi, tamasuk mamisahakan pasien matan nang lain gasan malindati kamungkinan inpeksi matan nang lain.
hypothesis: Rumah sakit sudah maumpati protokol gasan kada mamarah infeksi, tamasuk mamisahkan pasiennya dari urang lain gasan mencegah kemungkinan infeksi urang lain.

source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
reference: Sabalum The Simpsons, Simon sudah bagawi di babarapa pamentasan di macam-macam posisi.
hypothesis: sabalum The Simpsons Simon sudah bagawi di babarapa acara di bamacam posisi.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
reference: Salawas tahun 1980 inya bagawi di pamentasan nang kaya Taxi, Cheers, wan The Tracy Ullman Show.
hypothesis: Salawas 1980-an sidin bagawi di acara kaya Taxi, Cheers, wan The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
reference: Di tahun 1989 inya mambantui maulah The Simpsons wan Brooks wan Groening, lawan jua diparcayai gasan marekrut tim panulis pamentasan nang pamulaan.
hypothesis: Tahun 1989 sidin bantu mambantuk The Simpsons lawan Brooks wan Groening, wan bertanggung jawab gasan maniring tim panulis pertamanya.

source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
reference: Biar imbah maninggalakan pamentasan di tahun 1993, inya tatap manjadi produser eksekutif, wan tatap manarima puluhan juta dolar saban musim sabagai royalti.
hypothesis: Walaupun maninggal akan acara tahun 1993 sidin manjaga gelar produser eksekutif, wan terus manarima puluhan juta dolar setiap musim sebagai royalti.

source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
reference: Hanyar haja kantor habar Cina Xinhua mahabarakan sabuah pasawat sudah dibajak.
hypothesis: Sebelumnya, agensi berita Cina Xinhua melaporkan bahwa pesawat akan dirampas.

source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
reference: Habar pandudian memadahi pasawat ngitu mandapat ancaman bom wan disimpangakan babulik ka Afganistan, mandarat di Kandahar.
hypothesis: Laporan tarus lalu manunjukakan pesawat itu mandapatakan ancaman bom wan diarahakan pulang ka Afghanistan, mendarat di Kandahar.

source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
reference: Habar awal memadahakan pasawat disimpangakan babulik ka Afganistan imbah ditulakakan pandaratan darurat di Ürümqi.
hypothesis: Laporan awal ujar pesawat itu diarahkan pulang ke Afghanistan imbah dihalang mendarat darurat di Ürümqi.

source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
reference: Kacalakaan udara sudah rancak di Iran, nang mana baisi armada tuha nang kada tarawat baik gasan pamarintah wan gasan operasi militer.
hypothesis: Kacilakan udara rancak di Iran, nang baisi armada nang tuha nang kada baik dijaga gasan operasi sipil wan militer.

source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
reference: Sanksi internasional nang maksudnya pasawat hanyar kada kawa ditukari.
hypothesis: Sanksi internasional mananduiakan kada kawa manukar pesawat hanyar.

source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
reference: Hanyar minggu ngini, kacalakaan saurang pulisi helikupter maakibatakan tiga ikung urang maninggal wan tiga ikung labih luka-luka.
hypothesis: Awal minggu ini, tabrakan helikopter polisi mambunuh tiga urang wan manyakiti tiga lagi.

source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
reference: Bulan samalam Iran malihat bancana angin paling buruk dalam babarapa tahun pas sabuah pasawat manuju Armenia gugur, manewasakan 168 di pasawat.
hypothesis: Bulan lalu Iran melihat bencana udara terburuknya dalam beberapa tahun pas pesawat penerbangan menuju Armenia jatuh, menewaskan 168 orang di atas kapal.

source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
reference: Di bulan nang sama malihat pasawat lain maliwati jalur pasawat di Mashald lalu maranjah ka dinding, manewasakan tujuh belas urang.
hypothesis: Bulan nang sama melihat pesawat lain maninggang landasan palay di Mashhad wan manimpa tembok, maninggalakan tujuh belas.

source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
reference: Aerosmith mambatalakan sisa konser dalam tur buhannya.
hypothesis: Aerosmith sudah batal konser nang tersisa di turnya.

source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
reference: Band rok ngitu dijadwalakan ka Amerika Serikat wan Kanada sampai 16 September.
hypothesis: Gendang rock itu harus manimbau Amerika Serikat wan Kanada sampai 16 September.

source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
reference: Buhannya sudah mambatalakan tur ngitu limbah panyanyi utama Steven Tyler mandapat cidira limbah gugur matan panggung pas partunjukan pas 5 Agustus.
hypothesis: Bubuhannya batampal turnya imbah penyanyi utama Steven Tyler tabaluk imbah inya jatuh matan panggung sambil bamain pada 5 Agustus.

source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
reference: Murray kahilangan set partamanya dalam babah tambahan imbah kaduduanya saling mampartahanakan satiap serpis di satiap set.
hypothesis: Murray kalah set pertama dalam istirahat tie imbah kadua urang nang manjaga saban servis di set.

source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
reference: Del Potro baisi kauntungan awal di set kadua, tapi ngini maharusakan babak tambahan imbah mancapai 6-6.
hypothesis: Del Potro baisi kaunggulan awal di set kadua, tapi ini jua mamarluakan istirahat imbang imbah mancapai 6-6.

source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
reference: Potro sawat manarima pangubatan di bahunya wayah ini tapi kawa babulik ka parmainan.
hypothesis: Potro menerima perawatan di bahu sidin pada titik ini tapi berhasil kembali ke permainan.

source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
reference: Program ngitu dimulai jam 8.30 p.m. waktu satampat (15.00 UTC).
hypothesis: Program dimulai pas pukul 8:30 malam waktu lokal (15.00 UTC).

source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
reference: Panyanyi tarkanal saluruh nagara mamparsambahkan bhajans, atawa lagu kabaktian, gasan batisnya Shri Shyam.
hypothesis: Panutuhan terkenal di saluruh nagara manugerahkan bhajans, atawa lagu-lagu dedikasi, ka kaki Shri Shyam.

source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
reference: Panyanyi Sanju Sharma mamulai malam, diumpati uleh Jay Shankar Choudhary. Manampilakan chhappan bhog bhajan juwa. Panyanyi, Raju Khandaelwal juwa mangawaninya.
hypothesis: Sembang Sanju Sharma mamulai malam, diikuti ulih Jai Shankar Choudhary. mangirimakan chhappan bhog bhajan jua. Sembang, Raju Khandelwal mairing sidin.

source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.

source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
reference: Dalam karjasama di NPWS wan Pakumpulan Olahraga Manembak Australia (NSW) Inc, relawan nang masuk parsyaratan direkrut, dalam pangawasan program parburuan Pakumpulan Olahraga Manembak.
hypothesis: Dalam kemitraan NPWS wan Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, sukarelawan nang kualifikasi direkrut, di bawah program perburuan Sporting Shooters Association.

source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
reference: Badasarkan Mick O’Flynn, Wakil Direktur Konservasi wan Warisan lawan NPWS, ampat panembak dipilih gasan operasi manembak partama manarima pamahaman sual kasalamatan wan patunjuk latihan.
hypothesis: Manurut Mick O'Flynn, Direktur Acting Park Konservasi dan Warisan di NPWS, ampat penembak nang dipilih gasan operasi penembak pertama menerima instruksi keselamatan dan pelatihan komprehensif.

source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
reference: Martelly basumpah di Dewan Pamilihan Samantara (CEP) nang hanyar nang baangguta sambilan ikung sumalam.
hypothesis: Martelly manumpah dalam Dewan Pilkada Pamarintah (CEP) hanyar nang baisi sembilan anggota semalam.

source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
reference: Ngini CEP-nya Martelly nang kalima dalam ampat tahun.
hypothesis: Ini adalah CEP ka lima Martelly dalam ampat tahun.

source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
reference: Bulan kamarian komisi prisiden mausulakan pangunduran diri CEP nang tadahulu sagan bagian pangukuran nagara manuju pamilihan nang hanyar.
hypothesis: Bulan lalu sabuah komisi presiden mamarandakan pengunduran diri CEP sabalumnya sabagai bagian dari paket langkah gasan mamindahakan nagara ka paring pamilihan hanyar.

source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
reference: Komisi ngitu marupakan jawaban Martelly gasan protes anti-rezim nang maluas nang bamula di bulan Oktober.
hypothesis: Komisi ngini adalah tanggapan Martelly gasan protes anti-rezim nang mulai di bulan Oktober.

source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
reference: Takananya-aksi protes bakakarasan disababakan uleh kagagalan ma’adaakan pamilu, nang harusnya diadaakan tahun 2011.
hypothesis: Protes-protes nang kadang-kadang ganas dipicu oleh gagal maulah pamilihan, babarapa dijadwalakan sejak 2011.

source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
reference: Sakitar 60 kasus kasalahan fungsi iPods nang kapanasan sudah dilapurakan, manyababakan anam kabakaran wan maulah ampat urang mandarita luka banam ringan.
hypothesis: Sekitar 60 kasus pemanas iPod nang kada berfungsi sudah dilaporkan, manyababakan seberataan enam kebakaran wan maninggalakan ampat urang lawan luka bakar ringan.

source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
reference: Kamantrian Ekonomi Japan, Pardagangan wan Industri Jepang (METI) baujar kalau ngini sudah manyadari 27 kacalakaan nang baraitan ka parangkat.
hypothesis: Kamentrian Ekonomi, Perdagangan wan Industri (METI) Japang ma'atakan bahwa inya sudah tahu akan 27 kecelakaan nang bahubungan lawan perangkat-perangkat ini.

source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
reference: Minggu kamarian, METI mahabarakan kalo Apple sudah mahabari 34 panambahan kacalakaan kapanasan, nang mana buhan parusahaan manyambatnya "kada-sarius."
hypothesis: Minggu lalu, METI mengumumkan bahwa Apple telah memberitahunya tentang 34 insiden pemanas berlebihan tambahan, nang di sebut perusahaan "tidak serius".

source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
reference: Kamantrian marispon wan manyambat panangguhan lapuran Apple "disayangakan banar."
hypothesis: Kamentrian manjawab dengan manyabuik penundaan Apple laporan "sebenarnya menyesal".

source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
reference: Gampa bumi mehantak Mariana pas jam 07:19 pagi waktu lukal (09:19 malam Jumat GMT)
hypothesis: Guncangan bumi nang tajadi di Mariana pas pukul 07:19 pagi waktu setempat (09:19 malam GMT Jumat).

source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
reference: Kantor manajemen darurat Mariana Utara manyambat bahuwa kadada karusakan nang disampaiakan ka dalam negeri.
hypothesis: Kantor manajemen darurat Northern Marianas ujar kadada karusakan nang dilaporakan di nagara itu.

source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
reference: Wan jua Pusat Peringatan Tsunami Pasifik manyambat bahuwa kadada tanda-tanda gasan ada Tsunami.
hypothesis: jua Pusat Peringatan Tsunami Pasifik bilang kadada tanda Tsunami.

source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
reference: Saikung bakas pulisi Filipina manyandera turis Hong Kong wan membajak bis buhannya di Manila, ibu kota Filipina.
hypothesis: Sabuting mantan polisi Filipina manjaga wisatawan Hong Kong sabagai sandiran lawan manculik busnya di Manila, ibu kota Filipina.

source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
reference: Rolando Mendoza manimbakakan sinapang M16-nya ka tuju bubuhan turis.
hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza mamunculkan senapan M16nya ka turis.

source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
reference: Babarapa sandera sudah disalamatakan wan anam ikung sudah dipastiakan mati sajauh ngini.
hypothesis: Beberapa sandera sudah ditarikan dan paling kada enam sudah dikonfirmasi mati sampai saat ini.

source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
reference: Anam sandera, tamasuk kanakan lawan urang tuha, dilapas badahulu, baimbaian lawan babarapa tukang-kudak matan Filipina.
hypothesis: Enam pantang, tamasuk kakanakan wan urang tuha, dibebaskan awal, sama lawan fotografer Filipina.

source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
reference: Bubuhan tukang kudak limbah tu menggantiakan saikung bibinian tuha nang mambutuhkan kakus. Mendoza ditimbak mati.
hypothesis: Pamimpin fotografer imbah itu maambil wadah saurang wanita nang sudah tuha pas sidin mamarluakan toilet. Mendoza ditembak mati.

source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
reference: Liggins maumpati jajak abahnya wan mamulai karir di bidang pengubatan.
hypothesis: Liggins maumpati langkah bapannya wan mamulai karir di bidang kedokteran.

source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
reference: Inya dilatih sabagai spesialis kabidanan imbah tu mamulai bagawi di Rumah Sakit Nasional Binian Auckland tahun 1959.
hypothesis: Sidin dilatih sabagai ahli babinian wan mulai bagawi di Rumah Sakit Wanita Nasional di Auckland pada tahun 1959.

source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
reference: Salawas inya bagawi di rumah sakit Liggins mulai manyalidiki parsalinan primatur pas wayah kada hauran.
hypothesis: Wayah inya bagawi di rumah sakit Liggins mulai manyiasatakan kelahiran dini wayah sidin.

source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
reference: Panalitiannya manunjukakan kalo hormon dikalola ngitu cagar meolah lakas partumbuhan paru-paru janin.
hypothesis: Penelitian sidin manunjukakan amun amun hormon diatur akan mempercepat kamatangan paru-paru janin bayi.

source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
reference: Xinhua mahabarakan kalo panyalidik pamarintah mandapatkan dua 'kotak hirang' rakaman panarbangan di hari Arba.
hypothesis: Xinhua melaporkan bahwa penyelidik pamarintah mandapatakan dua rekaman penerbangan 'kotak hitam' pada Rabu.

source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
reference: Sasama pagulat juwa mambari panghormatan ka Luna.
hypothesis: Sabuting lawan paju jua mambari panghormatan ka Luna.

source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
reference: Tommy Dreamer baucap, "Luna ngini Ratu Ekstrim pamulaan. Menejer partamaku. Luna maninggal di malam dua bulan. Lumayan unik nang kaya inya jua. Binian nang kuat."
hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer bilang "Luna adalah ratu pertama Extreme, manajer pertama ku, Luna meninggal di malam dua bulan, unik banar sama kaya sidin, wanita kuat".

source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels beujar kalau "Luna tuh sama anihnya kaya ulun… kikira bisa labih…sayang inya wan cagar kaganangan lawan inya…mudahan inya ada di tampat nang bagus."
hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels manunjukakan bahwa "Luna adalah aneh kaya aku... mungkin labih... mancintainya wan akan merindukan sidin... mudah-mudahan sidin di wadah nang labih baik".

source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
reference: Matan 1.400 urang mamilih sabalum pamilihan federal tahun 2010, nang manantang Australia manjadi sabuah Republik batambah 8 parsin dari tahun 2008.
hypothesis: Dari 1.400 urang nang disurvei sabalum parmintaan parusahaan federal 2010, nang manantang Australia manjadi republik maningkat 8 persen sajak 2008.

source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
reference: Pardana Manteri Julia Gillard bakaku pas kampanye pamilihan umum federal tahun 2010 kalo inya pacaya Australia musti jadi republik di pahabisan pamarintahan Ratu Elizabeth II.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri sementara Julia Gillard maanggap pas kampanye pamilihan federal 2010 bahwa sidin percaya Australia harus manjadi republik pada akhir kakuasaan Ratu Elizabeth II.

source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
reference: 34 parsen matan survey ngitu manyatakan kainginan Ratu Elizabeth II manjadi monarki pahabisan Australia.
hypothesis: 34 persen urang nang di jajak pendapat malibat pandangan ini, handak Ratu Elizabeth II jadi raja Australia nang terakhir.

source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
reference: Di pamungutan suara ikstrim, 29 persen matan survey parcaya Australia saharusnya manjadi Republik selakasnya, samantara 31 parsen parcaya Australia kada usah manjadi Republik.
hypothesis: Di ekstrim survei, 29 persen dari urang nang disurvei percaya Australia harus manjadi republik secepat mungkin, sementara 31 persen percaya Australia kada pernah jadi republik.

source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
reference: Pamanang mandali amas Olimpik bakunyung 100 mitir wan 200 mitir gaya bebas dalam tiga giliran di Partandingan Commonwealth, tapi gegara kaduhannya kabugarannya diraguakan.
hypothesis: Pemenang medali emas Olimpiade itu harus berenang dalam 100m dan 200m gaya bebas dan dalam tiga relays di Commonwealth Games, tapi karena keluhannya kebugarannya sudah diragukan.

source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
reference: Inya sudah kada kawa maminum ubat-ubatan gasan ma’ampihakan rasa sakitnya makanya buhannya ditangati matan partandingan.
hypothesis: Sidin kada kawa maminum obat nang diparluakan gasan manangani sakitnya karana kada kawa diulah dalam Olimpiade.

source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
reference: Curtis Cooper, saurang matematikawan wan Profesor ilmu kumputer di Universitas Central Missouri, sudah manamuakan bilangan prima paling ganal tanggal 25 Januari.
hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, seorang matematikawan dan profesor ilmu komputer di Universitas Missouri Tengah, telah menamuakan bilangan prima terbesar nang diketahui sampai wayah ini pada tanggal 25 Januari.

source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
reference: Babarapa urang mamariksa bujur kadanya panamuan mamakai parangakat karas wan parangkat lenak nang balain-lain dimulai di Pebruari wan ngini dihabarakan hari Salasa.
hypothesis: Beberapa urang manverifikasi penemuan memakai perangkat keras wan perangkat lunak nang balainan pada awal Februari wan itu diumumkan pada Selasa.

source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
reference: komet kikira bisa manjadi sumber pangiriman banyu ka bumi basamaan lawan zat urganik nang bisa babantuk protein wan mandukung kahidupan.
hypothesis: Komet mungkin jadi sumber banyu nang dikirim ke bumi beserta materi organik nang kawa mambantuk protein wan manjaga kehidupan.

source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
reference: Ilmuwan baharap mamahami kayapa planet tabantuk, khususnya kayapa bumi tabantuk, samanjak komet baranjahan wan Bumi di masa nang lalu.
hypothesis: Ilmuwan berharap gasan mangartiakan bagaimana planet mambantuk, apalagi bagaimana Bumi mambantuk, sajak komet tabrak lawan Bumi lawas banar.

source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
reference: Cuomo, 53, sudah mamulai kapamarintahannya labih awal tahun ngini wan maneken rancangan undang-undang bulan tadi mansahkan parnikahan sasama janis.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, mamulai jabatan gabenornya awal tahun ini wan manandatangani tagihan bulan lalu nang manarehakan pernikahan sesama jenis.

source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
reference: Inya badasarakan habar parihal "pandiran wan kalucuan Politik".
hypothesis: Sidin mangarani rumor-rumor itu sabagai "gambaran politik wan kebodohan".

source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
reference: Inya bataruh gasan mamanangakan jadi Presiden di 2016.
hypothesis: Sidin dikira handak bajalan gasan jadi presiden pada tahun 2016.

source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
reference: NextGen ngitu sistim nang FAA sambat cagar mambariakan pasawat gasan tarabang di jalur nang handap wan ma’imit jutaan galon minyak satiap tahun wan manatak emisi karbon.
hypothesis: NextGen adalah sistem nang diklaim FAA akan mamungkinakan pesawat terbang manunggang rute nang lebih pendek wan manjimatkan jutaan galon bahan bakar setiap tahun wan mengurangi emisi karbon.

source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
reference: Ngini mamakai teknologi badasar-satelit nang balawanan wan teknologi radar-darat-dasar gasan mabariakan pangandali lalu lintas udarama’arahakan pasawat wan katalitian nang labih baik wan mambari pilot informasi nang labih akurat.
hypothesis: Ngini mangguna'akan teknologi berbasis satelit lawan teknologi berbasis radar darat nang lawas gasan mamungkinakan pengendali lalu lintas udara gasan manunjukakan pesawat lawan akurasi nang labih tinggi wan mambari informasi nang labih akurat ka pilot.

source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
reference: Kadaeda angkutan tambahan nang diandak wan kureta atas tanah kada besetop di Wembley, wan parkiran mobil wan fasilitas-parkir-wan-kendaraan kadeda di wilayah ngitu.
hypothesis: Kadada transportasi tambahan nang diulah wan kereta bawah tanah kada akan berhenti di Wembley, wan fasilitas parkir wan parkiran wan naik kada tersedia di tanah.

source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
reference: Gair sabab kurangnya angkutan maningkatakan kamungkinan kalo partandingan cagar dipaksa ditandingakan sacara tatukup tanpa pandukung tim.
hypothesis: Takut kurangnya transportasi meulah kemungkinan bahwa permainan akan dipaksa gasan dimainkan di balik pintu tertutup tanpa pendukung tim.

source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
reference: Sabuting kajian dihabarakan di hari Kamis dalam jurnal Ilmiah nang dihabarakan di formasi janis burung hanyar di Pulau Ekuador Galápagos.
hypothesis: Studi nang diterbitkan Kamis di jurnal Science melaporkan tentang pambentukan spesies burung hanyar di Kepulauan Galápagos Ekuador.

source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
reference: Ilmuwan matan Universitas Princeton di Amerika Sarikat wan Universitas Uppsala di Swedia mahabarakan janis hanyar bakambang di dua ganarasi haja, biar proses ngini sudah diparcaya mamakan waktu talawas, sabab pambiakan di antara wabah burung parkit Darwin. Geospiza fortis, wan imigran kaktus fins, Geospiza kunirustris.
hypothesis: Peneliti matan Universitas Princeton di Amerika Serikat wan Universitas Uppsala di Swedia manarangakan spesies hanyar ngini bavolusi dalam dua generasi haja, walaupun proses ngini diyakini maambil labih lawas, karana pembiakan antara pinch Darwin endemik, Geospiza fortes, wan pinch kaktus imigran, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
reference: Amas bisa digawi manjadi banyak bantuk. Ngini bisa di gulung manjadi bantuk nang tipis.
hypothesis: Emas kawa diulah jadi macam-macam bentuk.

source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
reference: Ngini bisa ditarik ka kawat tipis, nang mana bisa dililit wan dianyam. Ngini juwa kawa di timpa atawa digulung manjadi lambaran.
hypothesis: Bisa ditarik jadi kawat tipis, nang kawa diutarakan wan diulah.

source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
reference: Ngitu bisa diulah tipis banar, wan bakait lawan nang lain. Ngitu bisa diulah tipis nang takadang dipakai maulah gambar lukisan tangan di buku nang disambat "naskah iluminati".
hypothesis: Buhannya kawa jadi halus banar, lalu dilampirakan lawan logam lain. Buhannya kawa jadi halus banar sahingga kadang-kadang dipakai gasan menghias gambar nang dicat tangan dalam buku nang disambat "Manuskrip nang tarang".

source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
reference: Ngini disambat sabagai pH kimia. Pian bisa maulah sabuah indikator mamakai jus kol habang.
hypothesis: Ini disambat pH kimia. Pian kawa meulah indikator memakai jus kubis merah.

source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
reference: Jus kol habang barubah warna targantung kaya apa kaasaman atawa dasar (alkalin) kimia ngitu.
hypothesis: Jus kubis mangubah warna tagantung lawan amun asam atawa dasar (alkalin) bahan kimia.

source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
reference: Level pH ditunjukakan uleh jumlah ion hidrogen (H dalam pH) di bahan kimia nang diuji.
hypothesis: Tingkat pH ditunjukakan lawan jumlah ion Hidrogen (H dalam pH) dalam bahan kimia nang diuji.

source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
reference: Ion Hidrogen ngitu proton nang baisi elektronnya malapas buhannya ngitu (mulai ngitu atom hidrogen tardiri matan sabuting proton wan sabuting elektron).
hypothesis: Ion hidrogen adalah proton nang baisi elektronnya dihapus dari mereka (karena atom hidrogen terdiri dari satu proton wan satu elektron).

source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
reference: Aduk kadua bubuk karingnyawan imbahtu, pakai tangan basah nang barasih, kacak ngitu anggaran jadi bola.
hypothesis: Bulikakan dua bubuk keringnya bersama-sama lalu, pakai tangan basah bersih, seretnya jadi bola.

source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
reference: Kalambapan di tangan pian cagar bareaksi lawan lapisan luar, nang mana cagar tarasa lucu wan mambantuk cangkang-cangkang.
hypothesis: Kelembapan di tangan akan bereaksi lawan lapisan luar, nang akan terasa lucu dan membentuk semacam cangkang.

source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
reference: Kota di Harappa wan Mohenjo-daro baisi wc simbur di andak tiap sabarataan rumah, tarait ka sistim pambuangan nang canggih.
hypothesis: Kota Harappa wan Mohenjo-daro baisi toilet nang luas di hampir setiap rumah, nang dipasang pada sistem limbah nang canggih.

source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
reference: Bakas sistim pambuangan sudah ditamuakan di parumahan di kota Minoan di Crete wan Santorini di Yunani.
hypothesis: Sisanya sistem limbah sudah ditamui di rumah-rumah kota Minoan di Kreta wan Santorini di Yunani.

source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
reference: Ada juwa wc di Masir bahari, Persia, wan Cina. Di paradaban Romawi, wc manjadi bagian rumah pamandian umum nang mana lakian wan binian bacampur baur di dalamnya.
hypothesis: Di Mesir kuno, Persia, wan Cina, ada jua toilet. Di peradaban Romawi, toilet kadang-kadang marupakan bagian dari rumah mandi umum di mana laki-laki wan bini ba'isi babarapa di parusahaan campuran.

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Wayah ikam manilpon urang nang ribuan mil jauhnya, ikam mamakai satelit.
hypothesis: Amun manarima panggilan lawan urang nang jauh ribuan mil, Pian manggunaakan satelit.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Satelit di luar angkasa mandapat panggilan imbah tu mamantulakan ka bawah, sacara capat.
hypothesis: satelit di angkasa mandapati panggilan lalu manunjukinya kembali, hampir langsung.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Satelit dikirim ka luar angkasa mamakai roket. Ilmuwan mamakai teleskop di luar angkasa sabab atmosfer Bumi maubah cahaya wan panjanakan kita.
hypothesis: Satellit ini dikirim ke angkasa ulih roket. Ilmuwan manggunaakan teleskop di angkasa marga atmosfer Bumi manyalahakan babarapa cahaya wan pandangan kita.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Ngini mamakai roket raksasa malabihi 100 kaki tingginya gasan maandak satelit atawa teleskop ka luar angkasa.
hypothesis: Mampu roket raksasa nang tinggi labih matan 100 kaki gasan mamasang satelit atawa teleskop ka angkasa.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Roda sudah maubah dunia sacara mankjubakan. Hal paling penting nang sudah digawi roda gasan kita yato mambari kita banyak kamudahan wan angkutan nang labih laju.
hypothesis: roda sudah mengubah dunia dengan cara luar biasa. Hal paling ganal nang telah dilakukan roda gasan kita adalah memberikan kita transportasi nang jauh lebih mudah dan lebih cepat.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Roda sudah mambawakan kita kureta, mutur, wan banyak angkutan nang lain.
hypothesis: Itu mambawa kami kereta api, mobil, wan banyak alat transportasi lainnya.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Di bawah buhannya ada kucing nang ukuran sadang nang mamakan mangsa baukuran sadang matan kalinci sampai ka kancil wan rusa.
hypothesis: Di bawahnya ada kucing ukuran menengah nang makan mangsa ukuran menengah mulai dari kelinci sampai antelop dan rusa.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Akhirnya, ada banyak kucing halus (tamasuk kucing inguan balapas) nang mamakan jauh labih baragam mangsa halus nang kaya sarangga, binatang pangarat, kadal, wan burung.
hypothesis: Terakhir, ada banyak kucing halus (termasuk kucing hewan peliharaan nang longgar) nang makan mangsa halus nang jauh lebih banyak kaya serangga, gatal, kadal, wan burung.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Rahasia kabarhasilannya yato konsep lekung, sabuting gawian nang istimiwa nang kucing baisi ngitu matan basaing wan nang lain.
hypothesis: Rahasia keberhasilan mereka adalah konsep niche, tugas khusus nang dimiliki setiap kucing nang mencegahnya bersaing lawan nang lain.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Singa ngitu kucing nang paling basosial, badiam di kalumpuk ganal nang disambat kawanan.
hypothesis: Singa adalah kucing nang paling sosial, hidup dalam kelompok ganal nang disambat prides.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Kawanan tabantuk matan sabuting sampai talu targantung jantan ganal, lawan sampai talu puluh batina wan anak-anaknya.
hypothesis: Bangga terdiri dari satu sampai tiga laki-laki dewasa nang bahubungan, bersama lawan sampai tiga puluh betina wan anak.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Nang batina rajin tu parak saikung lawan saikung, manjadi kaluarga ganal matan kaka-ading wan anak babini.
hypothesis: Kaki bibinian biasanya bahubungan rapat, jadi keluarga nang ganal dari kakak wan anak bini.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Kawanan singa baaksi nangkaya kawanan sarigala atawa hadupan, binatang nang handak sama kaya singa (tapi lain kucing) dalam hal batingkah, wan juwa mamatikan banar ka mangsanya.
hypothesis: Singa bangga bagawi kaya kawanan serigala atawa anjing, binatang nang mirip lawan singa (tapi kada kaya kucing ganal lainnya) dalam parilaku, wan jua sangat mematikan lawan mangsa.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Saurang atlit nang saraba bisa, macan kawa banaik-naik (maski kada lihai), bakunyung, malacung jarak jauh wan manjuhut lima kali labih kuat daripada kakuatan manusia.
hypothesis: Atlit nang baik, harimau kawa manjat (mauni kada baik), berenang, melompat jarak ganal wan manarik lawan lima kali kakuatan manusia nang kuat.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Macan ngitu ada di kalumpuk nang sama (Gen Panthera) nang kaya singa, macan tutul, wan jaguar. Ampat kucing ngini haja nang kawa maraung.
hypothesis: Harimau adalah salah satu kelompok (Genus Panthera) lawan singa, leopard, wan jaguar.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Raungan macan kada sapanuh kaya ampun singa, tapi labih nang kaya kalimat garaman, kuriakan kata-kata.
hypothesis: Nangar harimau kada kaya nangar singa, tapi labih kaya kalimat kata nang ba'nang, nang ba'nang.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. Inya cagar manangkap warik, ular, binatang pangarat, wan burung kalo inya kawa. Handak sabarataan binatang nang Ocelot buru ngitu jauh labih halus daripada dirinya.
hypothesis: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. Inyo ka manangkok monyet, ula, tikus wan burung amun kawa. Hampir sabarataan binatang nang dicerekakan oleh ocelot jauh labih halus dari itu.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir kalo ocelot maumpati wan mandapati binatang gasan dimakan (dimangsa) malalui bau, manciumi di mana buhannya barada di atas tanah.
hypothesis: Ilmuwan bapikir bahwa ocelot maumpati wan manamuakan binatang gasan makan (sumbangan) lawan bau, maniris gasan mana buhannya sudah di tanah.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Inya kawa malihat dengan jalas dalam kadap lawan panglihatan malam, wan bagarak diam-diam, juwa. Ocelots mamburu mangsanya pakai cara basambunyi di sakitaran imbah tu marungkau mangsanya.
hypothesis: Buhannya kawa malihat baik banar di gelap lawan panglihatan malam, wan bagawi sacara halus jua. Ocelot mancing mangsa buhannya dengan ma'gabung lawan lingkungan buhannya lalu manumpak mangsa buhannya.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Pas kalumpuk halus makhluk hidup (dalam populasi halus) tapisah matan pupulasi utamanya wadahnya baasal (misalnya inya pindah ka wilayah pagunungan atawa sungai, atawa kalau inya pindah ka pulau hanyar jadi inya ngalih handak babulik) inya cagar rancak marasa ada wadah nang balain matan nang buhannya dahulu.
hypothesis: Pas sabuting kalompok halus dari makhluk hidup (sabuting populasi halus) dipisahakan matan populasi utama nang datangnya (kaya amun buhannya pindah di atas rantai gunung atawa sungai, atawa amun buhannya pindah ka pulau hanyar supaya buhannya kada kawa mudah baubah pulang) buhannya rancak akan manamui diri dalam lingkungan nang lain daripada buhannya di sabalumnya.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Lingkungan nang hanyar ngini baisi sumber nang balain wan pasaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar cagar parlu sifat nang balain atawa manyasuaiakan manjadi pasaing labih kuat daripada apa nang buhannya parlu sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Lingkungan hanyar ngini baisi sumber daya nang balain wan pesaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar akan mamarluakan ciri atawa adaptasi nang balain gasan jadi pesaing nang kuat daripada nang diparluakan sabalumnya.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Populasi awal balum barubah sama sakali, ngitu masih parlu panyasuaian nang sama kaya sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Populasi asli kada berubah sama sekali, mereka masih butuh adaptasi nang sama kaya sebelumnya.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Waktu balalu, populasi hanyar mulai manyasuaiakan ka lingkungan hanyarnya, buhannya mulai kurang mehatiakan wan kurang katuju wan populasi nang lain.
hypothesis: Seiring waktu, seiring populasi hanyar mulai manadap akan lingkungan hanyar buhannya, buhannya mulai malihat kada kaya populasi lain.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Padahal lah, ribuan atawa jutaan tahun nang lalu, dua populasi cagar talihat balain banar nang mana buhannya kada kawa disambat matan spesies nang sama.
hypothesis: Akhirnya, imbah ribuan atawa bahkan jutaan tahun, dua populasi akan tampak sangat berbeda sehingga kada kawa disambat spesies nang sama.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Kami manyambatnya ngini proses manspesialkan, nang cuma baarti mambantuk spesies hanyar. Panspesialan ialah konsekuensi nang kada kawa diabaiakan wan bagian nang penting banar matan evolusi.
hypothesis: Kita manggambarakan proses ngini spesies, nang artinya pambentukan spesies hanyar. Spesiasi adalah konsekuensi nang kada kawa dihindari wan bagian nang panting banar dari evolusi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Tanaman maulah oksigen nang dihiyut manusia, wan buhannya maambil karbondioksida nang dihambusakan manusia (ngitu pang, bahinak).
hypothesis: Tumbuhan meulah oksigen nang dihirupakan manusia, wan inya maambil karbon-dioksida nang dihirupakan manusia (yaitu, nang dihirupkan).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Tanaman maulah makanannya surang matan matahari malalui fotosintesis. Buhannya juwa manyadiakan kanaungan.
hypothesis: Tumbuhan maulah makanan matan matahari malalui fotosintesis. Tumbuhan jua mambari bayangan.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Kami maulah rumah kami pakai tanaman wan maulah baju pakai tanaman. Kabanyakan makanan nang kami makan ngitu tanaman-tanaman. Kadeda tanaman, binatang-binatang kada kawa batahan.
hypothesis: Kami maulah rumah matan tumbuhan wan maulah baju matan tumbuhan. Kabanyakan makanan nang kami makan adalah tumbuhan. Tanpa tumbuhan, binatang kada kawa hidup.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus marupakan pamangsa puncak di masanya, jadi inya kada takut apa haja, kacuali mosasaurus lainnya.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus adalah predator puncak zamannya, jadi inya kada takut apa-apa, kecuali mosasaurus lain.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Rahangnya nang panjang bahambur wan labih matan 70 gigi nang landap nang kaya silit, diumpati wan saparangkat tambahan di langit-langit muntungnya, nang baarti bahuwa kadada jalan kaluar gasan apa haja nang malalui jalannya.
hypothesis: Cangkunya nang panjang diisi labih matan 70 gigi tajam kaya pisau, ditambah satu set tambahan di atap mulutnya, nang artinya kadada jalan malapeh gasan apa jua nang maliwati jalannya.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Kita kada tahu pasti, tagal natu mungkin baisi ilat nang bacabang. Makanannya tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus nang lain, wan natu bahkan bisa jadi kanibal.
hypothesis: Kita kada tahu pasti, tapi mungkin inya baisi lidah nang garing. Makanannya tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus lain, wan mungkin inya bahkan jadi kanibal.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Natu jua manyarang apa haja nang masuk ka banyu, bahkan dinusaurus ganal nang kaya T. rex kada bakal sabanding lawan natu.
hypothesis: Ia jua menyerang apa jua nang masuk ka dalam banyu; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa kaya T. rex kada kawa manandinginya.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Biar kabanyakan makanannya talihat sama gasan kita, buhan Rumawi gin baisi hidangan aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi hutan, burung marak, ular, wan sajanis binatang pangarat di sambat durmus
hypothesis: Walaupun kebanyakan makanan urang bahari sudah tahu, tapi urang Roma baisi makanan nang aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi liar, merak, siput, wan jenis tikus nang disambat tikus

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Parbidaan lainnya pas urang miskin wan binian mamakan makanannya sambil duduk di kursi, lakian sugih katuju ma’adakan jamuan ba-sama-sama nang mana buhannya barabah di higa makanannya sambil mamakan makanan buhannnya.
hypothesis: Babeda lagi adalah, samantara urang miskin wan bibinian tu makan sambil duduk di kursi, urang kaya katuju maulah pesta bersama di mana buhannya baubah di pinggir sambil makan.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Makanan Rumawi bahari kada mamasukakan makanan nang barasal matan Eropa matan Amerika atawa matan Asia di abad dudi-dudi.
hypothesis: Makanan Romawi kuno kada kawa termasuk makanan nang datang ka Eropa dari Amerika atawa Asia di abad-abad berikutnya.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Umpamanya, buhannya kada baisian jagung, atawa tumat, atawa kantang, atawa cuklat, wan kadada Rumawi bahari nang suah marasai daging kalkun.
hypothesis: Misalnya, kada ada jagung, kada ada tomat, kada ada kentang, kada ada kakao, wan kada ada urang Romawi bahari nang pernah mencicipi kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Buhan Babilonia maulahakan masing-masing dewanya sabuah kuil nang diparcaya sabagai rumah dewa ngitu.
hypothesis: Urang Babil mambangun kuil utama gasan satiok dewata nang diaku sabagai rumah dewa.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Urang-urang mambawa sasaji gasan dewa-dewa ngitu lalu pandita maurusi kabutuhan dewa-dewa ngitu lawan maadaakan upacara-upacara wan pestipal-pastipal.
hypothesis: Urang-urang mambawai kurban ka dewata wan imam-imam mancuba gasan manolong parlu dewata malalui upacara wan parayaan.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Satiap kuil baisi halaman kuil nang tabuka wan sabuting wadah karamat di dalam nang pandita haja kawa masuk.
hypothesis: Sabarapa kuil baisi halaman kuil nang terbuka wan imbah itu wadah suci nang hanya kawa masuk ulih imam.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Takananya piramida husus babantuk manara, dingarani ziggurat, diulah gasan jadi bagian kuil.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang manara nang bapiramida, nang disambat ziggurat, dibangun gasan jadi bagian dari kuil-kuil.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Bagian atas manara ngitu wadah suci gasan si dewa.
hypothesis: Di atas manara itu adalah wadah suci khusus gasan dewa.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Iklim hangat di Timur Tangah, rumah kada tapi penting.
hypothesis: Di iklim hangat Timur Tengah, rumah kada penting banar.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Kabanyakan kahidupan kaluarga Ibrani balangsung di udara tabuka.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan kehidupan kaluarga Ibrani tajadi di udara terbuka.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Buhan binian bamasak di halaman; tuku-tuku buka mahadap langsung ka jalan. Batu dipakai gasan maulah rumah-rumah.
hypothesis: Wanita mamasak di halaman; toko-toko cuma wadah nang terbuka nang manatap ka jalan. Batu dipakai gasan mambangun rumah.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Kadada hutan-hutan nang ganal di banua Kanaan, jadi kayu haraganya larang banar.
hypothesis: Kadada hutan ganal di tanah Kanaan, jadi kayu mahal banar.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland jarang didiami. Di kesah-kesah Norse buhannya manyambat bahuwa Erik Si Habang dibuang matan Islandia sabab mambunuh, wan wayah haratan batulakan jauh ka barat, manamukan Greenland imbah tu mangarani ngitu Greenland.
hypothesis: Di sagas Norse, Erik Merah dikaluarakan matan Islandia gasan pembunuhan, wan pas bajalanan labih barat, manamuakan Greenland wan manyabuiknya Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Tagal kaya apa haja panamuannya, suku Eskimo sudah badiam di sana wayah ngitu.
hypothesis: Tapi apatah lai pandapekannya, suku Eskimo sudah hidup di sana wayah itu.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Biar masing-masing nagara adalah 'urang Skandinavia', ada banyak parbidaan antara rakyat, buhan raja, baju-baju, wan sajarah matan Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia, wan Islandia.
hypothesis: Walaupun masing-masing nagara adalah 'Scandinavia', ada banyak perbedaan antara urang-urang, raja, adat istiadat wan sajarah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia wan Islandia.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Amun ikam manuntun pelem National Treasure, ikam luku bapikir peta harta karun ditulis dibalakang Diklarasi Kamardikaan.
hypothesis: Amun Pian sudah malihat pilem National Treasure, Pian mungkin bapikir peta harta itu ditulis di belakang Deklarasi Kemerdekaan.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Katia, ngini tu kada bujur. Biar ada sapalih nang ditulis dibalakang dukumen, ngini tu lain pita harta karun.
hypothesis: Tapi, itu kada bujur, walaupun ada sesuatu nang ditulis di punggung dokumen itu, tapi kadada peta harta.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nang tatulis di balakang Diklarasi Kamardikaan ngitu kata-kata "Diklarasi Kamardikaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776". Bacaannya ada di bawah dukumen, tatulis tabalik.
hypothesis: Di bagian belakang Deklarasi Kemerdekaan ditulis kata-kata "Deklarasi Kemerdekaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776". Teksnya muncul di bawah dokumen, terbalik.

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Biar kadada nang tahu siapa nang manulis, dikatahui pas hahanyaran ngini tu ada, dukumin perkamen ganal ngitu (ganalnya 29¾ inci kali 24½ inci) digulung gasan disimpani.
hypothesis: Walaupun kada ada nang tahu pasti siapa nang manulisnya, tapi diketahui bahwa pas awal hidupnya, dokumen pargaman nang ganal (itu manukur 293⁄4 inci lawan 241⁄2 inci) digulung gasan disimpan.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: Makanya, ngini tu nangkaya catatan nang ditambahi haja gasan label.
hypothesis: Jadi, mungkin bahwa notasi ngitu ditambahi hanya sabagai label.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Hari-H pandaratan wan partampuran barikutnya sudah malapasakan Prancis bagian utara, tagal nang di salatan masih balum dilapas.
hypothesis: Pambangunan darat D-Day wan pertempuran berikutnya meulah utara Perancis bébas, tapi selatan masih kada bébas.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Ngini diatur "Vichy" Prancis. Urang-urang Prancis ngini nang badamai wan buhan Jerman di tahun 1940 imbah tu bagawi wan buhan panyarbu katimbang bakalahi lawan buhannya.
hypothesis: Di bawah kakuasaan urang Prancis "Vichy", urang-urang Prancis nang sudah maulah perdamaian lawan Jerman tahun 1940 wan bagawi lawan penjajah daripada malawan.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Pas 15 Agustus 1940, buhan Aliansi manyarbu bagian salatan Perancis, panyarbuan ngini tu bangaran "Uperasi Naga".
hypothesis: Tanggal 15 Agustus 1940, Sekutu mamasukakan Perancis selatan, invasi ngitu disambat "Operasi Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Dalam dua minggu haja buhan Amerika wan Angkatan Pambibasan Prancis sudah malapasakan Prancis bagian salatan wan babalik mahadapi Jerman.
hypothesis: Dalam dua minggu haja pasukan Amerika wan Perancis Bebas sudah mebebasakan Perancis selatan wan mamaling ka Jerman.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Paradaban ngitu budaya tunggal nang tabagi-bagi uleh sakulumpuk ganal urang nang badiam wan bagawi baimbai sabagai masyarakat.
hypothesis: Peradaban adalah budaya tunggal nang dibagi oleh sekelompok besar urang nang hidup wan bagawi secara koperatif, masyarakat.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Kata paradaban bamula dari Bahasa Latin civilis, baarti sipil, bahubungan ka Bahasa Latin civis, baarti panduduk, wan lingkungan, baarti kuta atawa nagara-kuta, wan jua kaya apapun jua mandifinisiakan ukuran masyarakat.
hypothesis: Kata peradaban datang dari bahasa Latin civilis, nang artinya sipil, bahubungan lawan bahasa Latin civis, nang artinya warga negara, wan civitas, nang artinya kota atawa kota-negara, wan nang jua jua jua jua jua cara mendefinisikan ukuran masyarakat.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Nagara-kuta ngitu pandahulunya nagara. Budaya paradaban bearti mawarisakan pangatahuan malalui babarapa ganarasi, sabuting jajak budaya nang balangsung wan panyabaran nang marata.
hypothesis: Kota-negara adalah pendahulu bangsa. Budaya peradaban menyiratakan pengamatan pengetahuan di antara beberapa generasi, jejak budaya nang bertahan dan penyebaran nang adil.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Budaya halus rancak punah kadada maninggalakan bukti sajarah nang baraitan wan gagal dikatahui sabagai paradaban nang sasuai.
hypothesis: Budaya halus rancak hilang tanpa meninggalkan bukti sejarah nang relevan wan gagal diakui sebagai peradaban nang tepat.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Salawas Perang Ripulusiunir, talu welas nagara partama mambantuk sabuting kapamarintahan pusat nang lamah—lawan buhan Diwan nang manjadi sabubutingannya bagian—di bawah Pasal-Pasal Kunfidirasi.
hypothesis: Selama Perang Revolusi, tiga belas nagara bagian partama-tama mambantuk pamarintah pusat nang lemah lawan Kongres sabagai satu-satunya komponen nang di bawah Pasal Konfederasi.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Diwan kurang baisi kakuatan gasan manganaakan pajak, wan, sabab kadada iksikutif nasiunal atawa buhan kahakiman, inya ma’andalakan uturitas nagara, nang rancak kada mambantu, gasan manjalanakan sabarataan undang-undangnya.
hypothesis: Kongres kada baisi kakuasaan gasan mamaksakan pajeg, wan, karana kadada eksekutif nasional atawa kahakiman, inya mangandung ka otoritas nagara, nang rancak kada baoperasi, gasan manegakkan sabarataan aksi-aksi sidin.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Ngini tu jua kada baisi uturitas gasan manulak paraturan pajak wan tarif antar nagara.
hypothesis: Ia jua kada baisi wewenang gasan menghapuskan hukum pajak wan tarif antara nagara.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Pasal-pasal ngini tu parlu kasapakatan bulat matan barataan nagara sabalum buhannya di amandemen wan nagara-nagara ma’anggap inting kapamarintahan pusat nang parwakilan-parwakilan buhannya takananya absin.
hypothesis: Pasal-pasal ngini mamarluakan persetujuan bulat matan sabarataan nagara bagian sabalum kawa diubah wan nagara-nagara maambil pamarintah pusat jadi ringan sehingga wakil-wakilnya rancak kada ada.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Bal sipak nasiunal Italia, baimbaian lawan tim nasiunal Jerman ngini tu tim kadua nang paling barhasil di dunia wan jua pamanang partandingan FIFA World Cup tahun 2006.
hypothesis: Sakarya, tim nasional Italia, bersama tim nasional Jerman adalah tim nang paling sukses kadua di dunia wan adalah juara Piala Dunia FIFA pada tahun 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
