reference: Tatapi kada ngitu saurangan haja, eksperimentasi, wan eksperimen ialah tes nang dipakai gasan mahilangakan sabuting atawa labih hipotesis nang mungkin, mangajuakan partanyaan, wan manggawi pangamatan wan jua manuntun panalitian ilmiah.
hypothesis: Kada saurang, tagal, percobaan, wan percobaan adalah ujian nang dipakai gasan menghilangkan satu atawa labih dari hipotesis nang mungkin, meulah pertanyaan, wan meulah pengamatan jua membimbing penelitian ilmiah.

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Naturalis wan filusuf fokus lawan bacaan-bacaan klasik, khususnya lawan Alkitab dalam bahasa Latin.
hypothesis: Ahli alam wan filsuf fokus pada teks klasik wan, khususnya, pada Alkitab dalam bahasa Latin.

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Nang ditarima ialah pandangan Aristoteles manganai sabarataan masalah ilmu pangatahuan, tamasuk psikologi.
hypothesis: Dipinandui adalah pandangan Aristoteles tentang semua hal sains, termasuk psikologi.

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: Pas pangatahuan manganai Yunani manurun, Barat mandapati dirinya taputus matan akar filusufis wan ilmiah Yunaninya.
hypothesis: Pas pengetahuan Yunani menurun, Barat manamuakan diri dipisahkan dari akar filsafat dan ilmiah Yunani.

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Banyak ritme nang diitihi dalam fisiologi wan parilaku rancak tuh bagantung banar lawan kabaradaan siklus endogen wan produksinya malalui jam biologis.
hypothesis: Banyak irama nang diamati dalam fisiologi wan parilaku rancak batatapakan pada adanya siklus endogen wan produksi mereka melalui jam biologis.

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Ritme periodik, nang lain sakadar respon lawan isyarat periodik eksternal, sudah didokumentasiakan gasan kabanyakan makhluk hidup, tamasuk bakteri, jamur, tumbuhan, wan binatang.
hypothesis: Ritme periodik, nang kada hanya tanggapan gasan isyarat periodik eksternal, sudah didokumentasikan gasan kebanyakan makhluk hidup, tamasuk bakteri, jamur, tumbuhan, wan binatang.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Jam biologis ialah osilator mandiri nang cagar malanjutakan periode siklus bajalan bibas bahkan tanpa adanya isyarat eksternal.
hypothesis: Jam biologis adalah osilator nang mandiri nang akan manerusakan periode bersepeda bebas bahkan tanpa tanda eksternal.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Eksperimen Hershey wan Chase ialah salah sabuting saran nang pamulaan bahuwa DNA ialah matiri genetik.
hypothesis: Eksperimen Hershey wan Chase adalah salah satu saran utama bahwa DNA adalah materi genetik.

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey wan Chase mamakai fag, atawa virus, gasan mananamakan DNA buhannya saurang ka dalam bakteri.
hypothesis: Hershey wan Chase mamakai phage, atawa virus, gasan mamimplanakan DNA buhannya sorang ka dalam bakteri.

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Buhannya manggawi dua parcubaan nang manandai DNA dalam fag lawan fosfor radioaktif atawa protein fag lawan belerang radioaktif.
hypothesis: Bubuhannya maulah dua eksperimen manandai DNA dalam phage lawan fosfor radioaktif atawa protein phage lawan sulfur radioaktif.

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Mutasi kawa baisian macam-macam dampak nang balain-lain tagantung lawan janis mutasinya, signifikansi bagian materi genetik nang tapangaruh wan apakah sel nang tapangaruh ialah sel garis-benihnya.
hypothesis: Mutasi kawa baisi bamacam efek nang balainan tagantung lawan jenis mutasi, pentingnya potongan materi genetik nang dipengaruhi wan apakah sel nang dipengaruhi adalah sel garis germinal.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Cuma mutasi di dalam sel garis-benih nang kawa diturunakan ka kakanakan, sadangkan mutasi di tampat lain kawa manyababakan kamatian sel atawa kanker.
hypothesis: Hanya mutasi di sel-sel garis germinal nang kawa diturunakan ka anak-anak, sedangkan mutasi di tempat lain kawa manyababakan kamatian sel atawa kanker.

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Pariwisata barbasis alam manarik urang-urang nang tartarik gasan mangunjungi daerah-daerah alam gasan manikmati pamandangan, temasuk tanaman wan binatang liar.
hypothesis: Pariwisata berbasis alam menarik urang nang tertarik gasan manamuakan daerah alam gasan manikmati pemandangan, tamasuk satua liar tumbuhan wan satua.

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Cuntuh kagiatan di lapangan tarmasuk berburu, maunjun, mamoto, mangamati burung, wan mangunjungi taman wan mampalajari inpormasi tantang ekosistim.
hypothesis: Contoh kegiatan di wadahnya tamasuk mancing, mancing, manfoto, manonton burung, manunjuakan taman wan manulih informasi tentang ekosistem.

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Cuntuhnya ialah mangunjungi, mamoto, wan balajar tantang orangutan di Borneo.
hypothesis: Contoh adalah manunjuaki, maambil gambar, wan malajari tentang organatuang di Borneo.

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Satiap pagi, urang-urang maninggalakan kota halus di padesaan pakai mobil gasan tulak ka wadah begawi buhannya wan dilalui ulih urang lain nang hanyar bulik dari wadah bagawinya.
hypothesis: Setiap pagi, urang-urang bajalanan dari kota-kota kampuang halus dalam mobil gasan pulang ka tempat gawian wan dihiasi ulih urang lain nang tujuan gawiannya adalah tempat nang hanyar bulik.

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Dalam kandaraan bulang-bulik nang dinamis ngini satiap urang entah kaya apa tahubung, wan mandukung, sistim kandaraan bardasarkan mobil sorangan.
hypothesis: Dalam transpor dinamis ini setiap orang secara entah bagaimana terhubung lawan, dan mendukung, sistem transportasi nang didasarkan pada mobil pribadi.

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Ilmu pangatahuan wahini manunjukan bahuwa ekonomi karbon ganal ngini sudah malapasakan biosper matan salah sabuting kondisi stabil nang talah mandukung parubahan manusia salama dua juta tahun tarakhir.
hypothesis: Ilmu pengetahuan wayah ini manunjukakan bahwa ekonomi karbon ganal ngini sudah mengusir biosfer dari salah satu keadaan stabilnya nang telah mendukung evolusi manusia selama dua juta tahun terakhir.

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Barataan urang talibat dalam masyarakat wan manggunakan sistim transpurtasi. Parak samuaan urang mangaluh tantang sistim transpurtasi.
hypothesis: Sabarataan urang bagabung dalam masyarakat wan mamakai sistem transportasi. Hampir sabarataan urang sambat tentang sistem transportasi.

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Di nagara barkambang Pian jarang mandangar kaluhan nang tingkatannya sama tantang kualitas banyu atawa jumbatan runtuh.
hypothesis: Di nagara maju jarang mandangar tingkat sambat nang sama tentang kualitas banyu atawa jembatan nang runtuh.

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Kanapa sistim transpurtasi mandapatakan kaluhan nang kaya ngitu, kanapa satiap hari sistim transpurtasi gagal? Apa teknisi transpurtasi kada mampu? Atawa sasuatu nang labih mandasar lagi tajadi?
hypothesis: Kenapa sistem transportasi mangulah keluhan kaya itu, kenapa kada kawa di hari-hari? apakah insinyur transportasi hanya kurang kompeten? atau apakah ada sesuatu nang labih mendasar nang terjadi?

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Arus lalu lintas ngitu mampalajari tantang pargarakan masing-masing pangamudi wan kandaraan antara dua titik wan hubungan nang buhannya lakukan satu sama lain.
hypothesis: Lalu lintas aliran adalah studi tentang gerakan pengemudi individu wan kendaraan antara dua titik wan interaksi nang bubuhannya maulah satu sama lain.

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Sayangnya, mampalajari arus lalu lintas liwar ngalih sabab parilaku pangamudi kada kawa ditangguhi lawan kapastian saratus persen.
hypothesis: Sayangnya, studi aliran lalu lintas ngalih karna perilaku supir kada kawa diprediksi lawan jaminan satus persen.

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Untungnya, buhan pangandara candarung baparilaku sampai kisaran nang cukup sama; sabab ngitu, arus lalu lintas candarung bisi kasamaan nang kuat wan kikira kawa ditunjukakan sacara matematis.
hypothesis: Untungnya, pengemudi cenderung balakukan dalam kisaran nang cukup konsisten; jadi, aliran lalu lintas cenderung baisi konsistensi nang cukup dan kawa diwakili secara matematis.

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Gasan manunjukakan arus lalu lintas nang tabagus, hubungan-hubungan talah tarjalin antara talu karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kapadatan, wan (3) kalajuan.
hypothesis: hagan labih baik mapresentasikan aliran lalu lintas, hubungan sudah ditamukan antara tiga karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kepadatan, wan (3) kacepetan.

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Hubungan-hubungan ngini manulung dalam parancanaan, parancangan, wan uperasi-uperasi sarana jalan raya.
hypothesis: Hubungan ngini manolong dalam perencanaan, desain, wan operasi fasilitas jalan raya.

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Sarangga ngitu binatang pamulaan nang mangudara. Kamampuan buhannya gasan tarabang manulung buhannya mahindari musuh labih mudah wan manamuakan makanan wan pasangan labih efisien.
hypothesis: Serangga adalah binatang partama nang maninggakan udara. Kamampuan buhannya gasan manunggang mambantu buhannya labih mudah malawan lawan wan mancari makanan wan pasangan nang labih efisien.

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Kabanyakan sarangga mamiliki kauntungan gasan kawa malipat sayapnya ka balakang di sapanjangan awak.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan serangga baisi kauntungan matan kawa manyambat sayapnya pulang di sepanjang awak.

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Hal ngini mambari buhannya jangkauan nang labih luas matan wadah-wadah halus gasan batabun matan pamangsa.
hypothesis: Hal ngini mambariakan buhannya wadah halus nang labih luas gasan manyimpan matan predator.

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Wayah ngini, sabuting sarangga nang kada kawa malipat ka balakang sayapnya tu capung wan lalat capung.
hypothesis: Hini, satu-satunya serangga nang kada kawa manulih sayapnya adalah lalat naga wan lalat may.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Ribuan waktu nang lalu, sorang lakian bangaran Aristarchus manyambat amun Sistim Tata Surya bagarak mangalilingi Matahari.
hypothesis: Ribuan tahun nang lalu, saurang urang nang banama Aristarchus bilang bahwa tata surya baputar di sekitar matahari.

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Babarapa urang bapikir inya bujur tapi banyak urang parcaya sabaliknya; amun Sistim Tata Surya bagarak mangalilingi Bumi, tamasuk Matahari (wan bahkan bintang-bintang nang lain).
hypothesis: Babarapa urang bapikir sidin bujur tapi banyak urang bapikir lawan; bahwa Sistem Surya bagerak di sekitar Bumi, tamasuk Matahari (dan bahkan bintang lainnya).

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Hal ngini kaliatan masuk akal, sabab Bumi kada karasa solah-olah bagarak, ya lo?
hypothesis: Ini tampak masuk akal, karna Bumi kada marasa kaya inya bagawi, kan?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Sungai Amazon ngini tu sungai pamanjangnya kadua wan pangganalnya di Bumi. Sungai ini mambawa labih matan 8 kali labih hibak banyu dibandingakan sungai pangganalnya kadua.
hypothesis: Sungai Amazon adalah sungai pangpanjang kadua wan pangganalnya di Bumi. Sungai ngini mambawa banyu labih matan 8 kali labih banyak daripada sungai pangganalnya kadua.

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Amazon juwa sungai paluasnya di Bumi, takananya lebarnya anam mil.
hypothesis: Sungai Amazon jua sungai paling luas di Bumi, kadang-kadang lebar 6 mil.

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: Sabanyak 20 parsen matan banyu nang mangalir matan sungai di planet ngini ka lautan baasal matan Amazon.
hypothesis: 20% banyu nang kaluar dari sungai-sungai di planet ini ka lautan datang matan Amazon.

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Sungai Amazon ngini 6.387 km (3.980 mil). Sungai ngini mangumpulakan banyu matan ribuan sungai-sungai halus.
hypothesis: Sungai Amazon utama adalah 6.387 km (3.980 mil).

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Biar bangunan piramida batu dilanjutakan sampai habis Karajaan Lawas, piramida-piramida Giza kada suah malangkahi ukuran wan kaunggulan tiknis konstruksi buhannya.
hypothesis: Walaupun pambangunan piramida di batu tarus sampai akhir Karajaan Tua, piramida Giza kada pernah dihiasi dalam ukuran wan keunggulan teknis konstruksi.

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Karajaan hanyar Mesir bahari tekajut lawan monumen-monumen babuyutan buhannya, nang pas ngitu baumur saribu tahun lawasnya.
hypothesis: Urang Mesir bahari nang baimigrasi ka Kerajaan Baru kagum lawan monumen nang sudah mandahuluinya, nang wayah itu sudah labih matan ribuan tahun.

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Populasi kota Vatikan sakitar 800. Ngini tu nagara mardeka tehalus di dunia wan nagara lawan populasi tarendeh.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan baisi populasi sakitar 800 urang. Ini adalah nagara independen pang halus di dunia wan nagara nang baisi populasi paling halus.

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Kota Vatikan mamakai bahasa Italia dalam undang-undang wan komunikasi rasminya.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan mangguna'akan bahasa Italia dalam undang-undang wan komunikasi rasmi.

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Bahasa Italia juwa ialah bahasa sahari-hari nang dipakai kabanyakan buhannya nang begawi di nagara bagian ngitu samantara bahasa Latin rancak dipakai dalam upacara kaagamaan.
hypothesis: Bahasa Italia jua adalah bahasa harian nang dipakai ulih kebanyakan nang bagawi di negara itu samantara bahasa Latin rancak dipakai dalam upacara agama.

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Sabarataan warga Kota Vatikan ialah Katolik Roma.
hypothesis: Kabarataan warga Kota Vatikan adalah Katolik Roma.

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Urang sudah mangatahui tentang unsur-unsur kimia dasar kaya amas, perak, wan tambaga matan jaman bahari, sabab sabarataan ngini ditamuakan di alam dalam bantuk asli wan relatip sadarhana gasan ditambang lawan alat-alat primitip.
hypothesis: Urang-urang sudah tahu tentang unsur kimia dasar nang kaya emas, perak, wan tembaga dari zaman kuno, karena ini sabarataan kawa ditamuakan di alam dalam bentuk asli wan relatif sederhana gasan ditambang lawan alat primitif.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristoteles, saurang filusuf, bateori bahuwa sabarataan diulah matan sabuah campuran matan sabuting atawa labih matan ampat elemen. Buhannya tu bumi, banyu, udara, wan api.
hypothesis: Aristoteles, filsuf, meulah teori bahwa sabarataan hudah terdiri dari campuran satu atawa labih dari ampat unsur.

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
reference: Ngini labih kaya empat kondisi matan materi (dalam urutan nang sama): karas, cair, gas, wan plasma, maskipun inya juwa bateori bahuwa buhannya baubah manjadi zat hanyar gasan mambantukakan apa nang kita lihat.
hypothesis: Ini labih mirip lawan ampat keadaan materi (dalam urutan nang sama): padat, cair, gas, wan plasma, walaupun inya jua meulah teori bahwa mereka berubah jadi zat hanyar gasan membentuk apa nang kita lihat.

source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
reference: lugam campuran sabujurnya sabuah campuran dua atawa labih lugam Jangan lali ada banyak unsur-unsur di tabel periodik.
hypothesis: Alloys pada dasarnya adalah campuran dua atau labih logam. Jangan lupa bahwa ada banyak elemen di tabel periodik.

source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
reference: Unsur-unsur kaya kalsium wan kalium dianggap lugam. Tantu haja, ada juwa lugam-lugam kaya perak wan amas.
hypothesis: Unsur-unsur kaya kalsium wan kalium dianggap logam. Tentu, ada jua logam kaya perak wan emas.

source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
reference: Pian kawa juwa bisi lugam nang tamasuk halus jumlah elemen nun-lugam kaya karbon.
hypothesis: Pian kawa jua baisi paduan nang baisi jumlah halus unsur non-metal kaya karbon.

source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
reference: Sagala sasuatu di alam semasta diulah matan materi. Sabarataan materi diulah matan partikel halus disambat atom.
hypothesis: Sagalanya di alam semesta terbuat dari materi. Semua materi terbuat dari partikel kecil yang disebut atom.

source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
reference: Atom-atom halus banar sahingga triliunan atom kawa masuk ka dalam periode di akhir kalimat ngini.
hypothesis: Atomnya sangat halus sehingga triliun-triliunnya bisa masuk dalam periode di akhir kalimat ini.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: Makanya, pensil ngitu manjadi kawal rakat gasan banyak urang pas dikaluarakan.
hypothesis: Jadi, pensil itu jadi kawan baik gasan banyak urang pas dipublikasikan.

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: Sayangnya, maraga cara manulis nang tahanyar sudah mancungul, pensil sudah diturunakan ka kadudukan wan kagunaan nang tarandah.
hypothesis: Sayangnya, karana metode tulisan nang hanyar muncul, pensil sudah diurangakan ka status wan pamakaian nang kurang baik.

source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
reference: Urang-urang wahini manulis pasan di layar komputer, kada parlu mamaraki rautan.
hypothesis: Urang-urang wayah ini manulis pasan di layar komputer, kada parlu datang parak lawan pemasah.

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: Urang kawa mahayalakan haja cagar jadi apa papan katik pas sasuatu nang tahanyar datang.
hypothesis: Urang kawa haja bapikir apa akan jadi keyboard pas ada nang hanyar datang.

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Bom fisi bagawi badasarakan prinsip bahuwa diparluakan energi gasan manggabungakan inti lawan banyak proton wan neutron.
hypothesis: Bom fissi bagawi lawan prinsip bahwa dibutuhkan energi gasan meulah babarapa inti lawan banyak proton wan neutron.

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Samacam kaya manarik karita barat ka atas bukit. Mamisahakan nukleus pulang imbah ngitu malapasakan sabagian energinya.
hypothesis: Macam menggulingkan gerobak berat ke atas bukit, membagi inti lagi lalu melepaskan sebagian energi.

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Babarapa atom baisian inti nang kada stabil nang baarti bahuwa buhannya tu lakas pacah liwat sadikit atawa kada pakai tunjulan.
hypothesis: Babarapa atom baisi inti kada stabil nang artinya buhannya cenderung pecah lawan sedikit atawa kada ada dorongan.

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Parmukaan Bulan diulah matan babatuan wan dabu. Lapisan luar Bulan disambat karak.
hypothesis: Pamukaan Bulan tadiri matan batu wan debu. Lapisan luar Bulan disambat kerak.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Karak ngitu tabalnya sakitar 70 km di sisi parak wan 100 km di sisi jauh.
hypothesis: keraknya sakitar 70 km tebal di sisi parak wan 100 km tebal di sisi jauh.

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Tatipis di bawah laut wan tatabal di bawah dataran tinggi.
hypothesis: Lebih tipis di bawah maria dan lebih tebal di bawah dataran tinggi.

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Mungkin ada tabanyak maria di sisi parak maraga karaknya tatipis. Lava tanyaman naik ka parmukaan.
hypothesis: Mungkin ada lebih banyak maria di sisi parak karna keraknya lebih tipis.

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Isi tiuri bapusat pada manamuakan apa nang maulah urang tagarak atawa manarik gasan buhannya.
hypothesis: Teori konten ba'pusat pada mencari apa nang maulah urang ba'titip atawa manarik'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan'akan.

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Tiuri-tiuri ngini manunjukakan bahuwa urang baisian kaparluan wan/atawa kahandak tartantu nang sudah tarinternalisasi pas buhannya mulai batuha.
hypothesis: Teori-teori ngini manunjukakan bahwa urang baisi parluan wan/atawa kahandak nang sudah di dalam dalam bila inya batambah dewasa.

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Tiuri-tiuri ngini malihat apa nang maulah urang-urang tartantu mahandaki hal-hal nang buhannya gawi wan hal-hal apa di lingkungannya nang bakal maulah buhannya manggawi atawa kada manggawi hal-hal tartentu.
hypothesis: Teori-teori ngini malihat apa nang ba'isi urang-urang tertentu nang mamaksa'akan buhannya handak hal-hal nang buhannya lakuakan wan apa hal-hal nang di lingkungan buhannya akan mamaksa'akan buhannya ba'ulah atawa kada ba'ulah hal-hal tertentu.

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Dua konten tiuri tarkanal ialah tiuri Hirarki Kebutuhan Maslow wan tiuri Dua Faktor Hertzberg.
hypothesis: Dua teori konten nang populer adalah Teori Hierarki Kebutuhan Maslow wan Teori Dua Faktor Hertzberg.

source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
reference: Sacara umum, dua parilaku kawa cungul pas manajer mulai mamimpin anak buahnya sabalumnya. Salah sabuting ujung spektrum mancuba gasan tatap manjadi “salah saikung dari lalakian” (atawa babinian).
hypothesis: Secara umum, dua perilaku kawa muncul pas manajer mulai memimpin mantan rekan-rekannya. Salah satu ujung spektrum mencoba gasan tetap jadi salah satu cowok (atau gadis).

source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
reference: Manajer nang kaya ini maalami kangalihan maulah kaputusan nang kada tarkanal, manggawi tindakan disipliner, maepaluasi kinerja, manatapakan tanggung jawab, wan maminta partanggungjawaban urang.
hypothesis: Jenis manajer ngini ngalih gasan maambil kaputusan nang kada populer, malakukan tindakan disiplin, evaluasi kinerja, manugerahkan tanggung jawab, wan ma'ulah urang-urang ba'isi tanggung jawab.

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Di ujung spektrum nang lain, sasaurang barubah manjadi susuk nang kada kawa dikanali nang marasa harus maubah samuaan nang sudah digawi kalumpuk wan manjadiakannya ampun inya.
hypothesis: Di tunggak lain spektrum, urang jadi individu nang kada kawa di kenal, nang bapikir inya harus maubah sabarataan nang sudah dilakoni timnya wan maulahnya jadi miliknya.

source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
reference: Kaya apa haja, pamimpin panghabisannya batanggung jawab atas kasuksisan wan kagagalan tim.
hypothesis: Pado akhirnyo, pamimpinlah nan manjadi tanggung jawab atas kasuksesan jo kegagalan tim.

source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
reference: Parilaku ini rancak maulah rangat antara pamimpin wan angguta kalumpuk lainnya.
hypothesis: Parilaku ngini rancak manyabapakan celah antara pamimpin wan sisanya tim.

source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
reference: Kalumpuk pirtual baisian standar kalabihan nang sama lawan kalumpuk tradisiunal, tatapi sadikit balainan.
hypothesis: Tim virtual dijaga pada standar keunggulan nang sama lawan tim konvensional, tagal ada perbedaan halus.

source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
reference: Angguta kalumpuk pirtual rancak tapakai sabagai titik kuntak gasan kalumpuk fisik langsung bubuhannya.
hypothesis: Anggota tim virtual rancak jadi titik kontak gasan kelompok fisik langsung.

source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
reference: Bubuhannya rancak baisian otonomi nang tabanyak daripada angguta kalumpuk tradisiunal maraga kalumpuk bubuhannya tu kawa batamuan sasuai lawan wilayah waktu nang balainan nang mungkin kada dipahami ulih manajemen lukal bubuhannya.
hypothesis: Buhannya rancak baisi otonomi nang labih tinggi daripada anggota tim konvensional karena tim buhannya kawa baumpati manuruik zona waktu nang balain nang mungkin kada dipahami oleh manajemen lokal buhannya.

source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
reference: Kahadiran “kalumpuk kada kalihatan” sejati (Larson wan LaFasto, 1989, p109) marupakan komponen unik matan kalumpuk pirtual juwa.
hypothesis: Kehadiran tim nang nyata nang kada kelihatan (Larson dan LaFasto, 1989, p109) jua merupakan komponen unik tim virtual.

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: “Kalumpuk kada kalihatan” ialah kalumpuk manajemen nang manjadi tujuan lapuran masing-masing angguta. Kalumpuk kada kalihatan manatapakan standar gasan satiap angguta.
hypothesis: Tim nang kada kelihatan adalah tim manajemen nang masing-masing anggota balapur. Tim nang kada kelihatan manyetel standar gasan masing-masing anggota.

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
reference: Kanapa suatu organisasi handak malalui proses nang mamakan waktu lawas dalam mandirikan organisasi pambelajaran? Sauting tujuan gasan manjalanakan kunsep pambelajaran urganisasi ialah inupasi.
hypothesis: Kenapa suatu organisasi handak malalui proses nang memakan waktu gasan mambangun organisasi belajar? Salah satu tujuan gasan mamaksakan konsep pembelajaran organisasi dalam praktik adalah inovasi.

source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
reference: Katika sabarataan sumber daya nang ada sacara efektif dipakai di sabarataan departemen fungsional matan sabuting organisasi, kreatipitas wan kecerdikan kawa tasebar.
hypothesis: Amun sabarataan sumber daya nang ada dipakai sacara efektif di seluruh departemen fungsional suatu organisasi, kreativitas wan kecerdasan kawa mancapai.

source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
reference: Sabagai hasil, proses organisasi bebagi gawi gasan mangatasi rintangan sakira kawa mendurung proses inupatif hanyar gasan malayani kabutuhan palanggan.
hypothesis: Akibatnya, proses organisasi nang bagawi babarapa gasan maninggalakan halangan kawa manyabapakan proses inovatif hanyar gasan mancapai parluannya.

source: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
reference: Sabalum sabuting organisasi kawa manjadi inupatif, kapamimpinan harus manciptaakan sabuting budaya inupasi wan juwa pangatahuan wan pambalajaran organisasi barsama.
hypothesis: Sabalum sabuah organisasi kawa inovatif, kapamimpinan harus maulah budaya inovasi serta pengetahuan bersama wan pembelajaran organisasi.

source: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
reference: Angel (2006), manjalasakan pandekatan Continuum sabagai mitode nang dipakai gasan manulungi organisasi mancapai tingkat kinerja nang labih tinggi.
hypothesis: Angel (2006), manjelasakan pendekatan Kontinuum sabagai metode nang dipakai gasan manolong organisasi mencapai tingkat kinerja nang labih tinggi.

source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
reference: Data neurobiologi mambari bukti fisik gasan pandekatan tiuritis gasan panyalidikan kognisi. Sakira mamparsampit wadah panalitian wan maulah jauh labih tapat.
hypothesis: Data neurobiologis mambari bukti fisik gasan pendekatan teoritis gasan penyelidikan kognisi. Oleh karena itu itu mamasukakan bidang penelitian wan meulahnya labih akurat.

source: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
reference: Korelasi antara patologi utak lawan parilaku mandukung buhan ilmuwan dalam panelitian buhannya.
hypothesis: Hubungan antara patologi otak wan parilaku manantuakan buhan ilmuwan dalam penelitian buhannya.

source: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
reference: Sudah matan dahulu dikatahui bahuwa parbedaan janis karusakan otak, trauma, luka, wan tumor mampangaruhi parilaku wan manyababakan parubahan babarapa fungsi mental.
hypothesis: Sudah lawas diketahui bahwa macam-macam pinarangan otak, trauma, lesi, wan tumor mempengaruhi parilaku wan manyababakan parubahan dalam babarapa fungsi mental.

source: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
reference: Badirinya teknologi hanyar mamungkinakan kita gasan malihat wan manyalidiki struktur wan proses utak nang balum suah talihat sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Peningkatan teknologi hanyar mamungkinakan kita malihat wan manliti struktur otak wan proses nang kada pernah dilihat sabalumnya.

source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
reference: Hal ngini mambariakan kita banyak informasi wan materi gasan maulah mudel simulasi nang manulungi kita mamahami proses di dalam pikiran kita.
hypothesis: Hal ngini mambariakan kita banyak informasi wan bahan gasan mambangun model simulasi nang mambantu kita memahami proses dalam pikiran kita.

source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
reference: Biarpun AI baisi konotasi ilmiah nang kuat, AI maulah cabang ilmu komputer nang liwar penting, manangani perilaku, pambalajaran, wan adaptasi cardas dalam masin.
hypothesis: Walaupun AI baisi konotasi nang kuat dari fiksi ilmiah, AI membentuk cabang ilmu komputer nang panting banar, nang baurusan lawan parilaku, pembelajaran wan adaptasi cerdas dalam mesin.

source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
reference: Panelitian di AI maumpatakan pambuatan masin gasan mangotomatisasi tugas-tugas nang mamarluakan parilaku cardas.
hypothesis: Penelitian di AI melibatkan meulah mesin gasan mengotomatisasi tugas nang mamarluakan perilaku nang cerdas.

source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
reference: Cuntuhnya tamasuk kendali, parancanaan, wan panjaduwalan, kabisaan gasan manjawab diagnosis wan tatakunan palanggan, lawan pengenalan tulisan tangan, suara wan muha.
hypothesis: Contohnya tamasuk kontrol, perencanaan wan penjadwalan, kemampuan gasan manjawab diagnosis wan pertanyaan pelanggan, serta pangakuan tulisan tangan, suara wan wajah.

source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
reference: Hal-hal nang kaya ngitu sudah manjadi disiplin ilmu tarsendiri, nang bafokus mambari solusi gasan masalah-masalah kahidupan nyata.
hypothesis: Hal-hal nang kaya itu sudah jadi disiplin nang terpisah, nang fokus gasan memberikan solusi gasan masalah kehidupan nyata.

source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
reference: Sistim AI wayah ngini rancak dipakai dalam bidang ekonomi, kadokteran, teknik wan militer, nang kaya nang sudah dibangun dalam babarapa aplikasi komputer rumah wan parangkat lunak pideo gim.
hypothesis: Sistem AI wayahini rancak dipakai di bidang ekonomi, kedokteran, teknik wan militer, nang sudah dibangun di babarapa aplikasi perangkat lunak komputer rumah wan video game.

source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
reference: Karyawisata ialah bagian basar kelas apa pun. Kada tapi rancak saurang guru handak mambawa murid-muridnya padahal mamakai bis lain pilihan ka suatu tampat.
hypothesis: Pamarintah umum handak mambawa muridnya ka wadah nang kada mungkin dipakai bas.

source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
reference: Teknologi menawarakan solusi lawan parjalanan lapangan pirtual. Buhan murid kawa malihat artefak musium, mangunjungi akuarium, atawa mangagumi seni nang indah pas duduk barsama kalas buhannya.
hypothesis: Teknologi mandapatakan solusi lawan kunjungan lapangan virtual. Murid kawa malihat artefak museum, manamu'akan akuarium, atawa manamu'akan seni indah sambil duduk lawan kelasnya.

source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
reference: Babagi pangalaman bajalan sacara pirtual juwa marupakan cara nang sangat bagus gasan mancarminakan parjalanan wan babagi pangalaman lawan kalas-kalas di wayah kaina.
hypothesis: Membagiakan pamindahan lapangan sacara virtual jua adalah cara nang baik gasan bapikir akan pamindahan wan mambagi pangalaman lawan kelas masa depan.

source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
reference: Pamisalannya, satiap tahun murid matan Bennet School di Carolina Utara mandisain sabuah situs web tantang parjalanan buhannya ka Ibu kuta nagara bagian, satiap tahun situs web tasabut dihanyari, tapi versi lawasnya tatap ada gasan manjadi buku kliping.
hypothesis: Misalnya, saban tahun, mahasiswa matan Sakola Bennet di Carolina Utara mamancangakan sabuah situs web tentang perjalanan ka Ibukota Negara, saban tahun situs webnya diubah, tapi versi lawas disimpan secara online gasan manjabat sabagai buku skrap.

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Blog juwa kawa mambantu maningkatakan panulisan murid. Katika buhan murid rancak mamulai pengalaman blognya lawan tata bahasa wan hijaan nang masih barantakan, kahadiran saurang panuntun sacara umum maubah hal tasabut.
hypothesis: Blog jua kawa membantu maningkatakan tulisan mahasiswa. Samantaro mahasiswa rancak mamulai pangalaman blognya lawan tatabahasa wan ejaan nang kada baik, kehadiran penonton umumnya mangubahnya.

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: Karana murid-murid ialah panuntun nang paling karitis, panulis blog mulai bausaha maningkatakan panulisan gasan manghindari karitik.
hypothesis: Karena mahasiswa rancak jadi penonton nang paling kritis, panulis blog mulai berusaha gasan maningkatakan tulisan gasan menghindari kritik.

source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
reference: Juwa manulis blog "mamaksa murid gasan manjadi labih mangarti tantang dunia di sakitarnya." Kabutuhan gasan mamberi makan minat gasan buhan panonton manginspirasi murid gasan manjadi pintar wan manarik (Toto, 2004).
hypothesis: "Blogging jua "memaksa siswa jadi lebih pintar tentang dunia di sekitarnya". Kebutuhan gasan mambari perhatian penonton menginspirasi siswa jadi pintar dan menarik (Toto, 2004).

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
reference: Blogging ngitu alat nang mainspirasi kolaborasi, wan manunjul murid supaya maluasi pambalajaran jauh di luar hari sakulah tradisiunal.
hypothesis: Blogging adalah alat nang menginspirasi kolaborasi, wan mendorong siswa gasan manjangakan pembelajaran jauh di luar hari sekolah tradisional.

source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
reference: Panggunaan blog nang tapat "kawa mambardayakan buhan murid lawan manjadi labih analitis wan karitis; lawan secara aktif marespon materi-materi Internet, buhan siswa kawa manatapkan posisinya dalam konteks tulisan lain wan juwa manguraikan pandangannya sandiri dalam isu-isu tatantu (Oravec, 2002).
hypothesis: "Panggunan nang pas dari blog" kawa mambangkitakan mahasiswa gasan manjadi labih analitik wan kritis; malalui bahubungan aktif lawan materi Internet, mahasiswa kawa mangartiakan posisi buhannya dalam konteks tulisan urang lain serta manggariskan perspektif buhannya sorang pada isu-isu tertentu (Oravec, 2002).

source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
reference: Ottawa ialah ibukota Kanada nang manarik wan dwibahasa sarta manampilkan babagai galeri seni wan museum nang manampilakan masa lalu wan masa kini Kanada.
hypothesis: Ottawa adalah ibu kota Kanada nang manarik, basua dua bahasa wan baisi sajumlah galeri seni wan museum nang manunjukakan masa lalu wan wayahini Kanada.

source: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
reference: Labih jauh ka selatan ialah banyu tarjun Niagara wan utara ialah rumah gasan kaindahan alam nang balum terjamah dari Muskoka wan seterusnya.
hypothesis: Salabih di selatan adalah Air Terjun Niagara wan di utara adalah rumah gasan kaindahan alam nang kada dieksplorasi dari Muskoka wan di luar.

source: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
reference: Samua hal ngini wan labih menyoroti Ontario sabagai apa nang dianggap sacara paling mawakili Kanada uleh urang luar.
hypothesis: Kabarataan hal ini wan labih manonjolkan Ontario sebagai apa nang dianggap sebagai Kanada khas oleh urang luar.

source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
reference: Wadah nang luas jauh ka utara ngitu jarang panduduknya wan babarapa gurun nang parak kada bapanghuni.
hypothesis: Daerah ganal di utara cukup jarang dihuni wan babarapa hampir hutan liar nang kada dihuni.

source: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
reference: Gasan parbandingan jumlah panduduk nang mangajutakan banyak urang: Ada labih banyak urang Afrika Amerika tinggal di AS daripada ada warga nagara Kanada.
hypothesis: hagan perbandingan populasi nang mengejutkan banyak: ada lebih banyak urang Afrika Amerika nang hidup di AS daripada ada warga Kanada.

source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
reference: Kapulauan Afrika Timur adanya di Samudera Hindia di lapas pantai timur Afrika.
hypothesis: Kapulauan Afrika Timur ada di Samudra Hindia di pasisir timur Afrika.

source: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
reference: Madagaskar sajauh ngini ialah nang pangganalnya, wan marupakan banua saurangan dalam hal satwa liar.
hypothesis: Madagaskar adalah nang paling ganal, wan benua nang mandiri dalam hal satua liar.

source: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
reference: Kabanyakan pulau-pulau halus ialah nagara merdeka, atawa takait lawan Perancis, wan dikanal sabagai resor pantai mewah.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan pulau-pulau halus adalah nagara-nagara independen, atau bahubungan lawan Perancis, wan dikenal sabagai resor pantai mewah.

source: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
reference: Urang-urang Arab juwa mambawa Islam ka negeri-negeri ngitu, wan manyabar luas di Komoro wan Mayotte.
hypothesis: Urang Arab jua mambawa Islam ka tanah-tanah, wan inya mandapatakan banyak di Comoros wan Mayotte.

source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
reference: Pangaruh wan panjajahan ulih Eropa dimulai pas abad 15, rahatan panjalajah Portugis Vasco da Gama manamuakan Jalur Tanjung matan Eropa ka India.
hypothesis: Pengaruh Eropa wan kolonialisme dimulai pas abad ka-15, pas penjelajah Portugis Vasco da Gama manamuakan Rute Kap dari Eropa ka India.

source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Di utara wilayah ngini dibatasi ulih Sahel, wan di selatan wan barat ulih Samudra Atlantik.
hypothesis: Di utara wilayah ini dibatasi oleh Sahel, wan di selatan wan barat oleh Samudra Atlantik.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Binian: Dianjurakan bahuwa satiap turis binian bapadah bahuwa buhannya sudah kawin, talapas dari status parkawinan nang sabujurnya.
hypothesis: Wanita: Disaranakan setiap wanita nang bajalanan manyambat bahwa mereka sudah kawin, kada peduli status kasunangan.

source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
reference: Cagar liwar mambantu juwa bila mamakai cincin (cuma jangan nang kalihatan larang).
hypothesis: Manuntung jua memakai cincin (hanya kada kaya nang kaya mahal banar.

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Babinian harus sadar bahuwa budaya nang balain kawa maakibatakan apa nang buhannya anggap sabagai palicihan wan rancak diumpati, tangan dikacak, dll.
hypothesis: Wanita harus sadar bahwa perbedaan budaya kawa manyabapakan apa nang dianggapnya penganiayaan dan kada jarang dituruti, ditangkap tangan, dll.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Basikap tagas pas manulak lakian, wan jangan takutan gasan mampartahanakan pandirian Pian (budaya nang balainan atawa kada, itu kada maulah sabarataannya baik-baik haja!).
hypothesis: Jadi tegas dalam menolak laki-laki, dan jangan takut gasan berdiri di atas dasar (perbedaan budaya atau tidak, itu kada baik-baik saja!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Kota mudirin Casablanca didiriakan ulih nelayan Berber pas abad 10 SM, wan dipakai ulih Fenisia, Romawi, wan Merenid sabagai palabuhan strategis nang disambat Anfa.
hypothesis: Kota modern Casablanca didiriakan ulih nelayan Berber pas abad ka-10 SM, wan dipakai ulih urang Fenisia, Romawi, wan Merenid sabagai palabuhan strategis nang disambat Anfa.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: Portugis mahancurakannya wan mambangunnya pulang lawan nama Casa Branca, Cuma ditinggalakan imbah gampa bumi pas tahun 1755.
hypothesis: Urang Portugis mambinasakan wan mambangun pulang di bawah ngaran Casa Branca, hanya gasan maninggalkannya imbah lindung bumi pada 1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Sultan Maroko mambangun pulang kuta itu sabagai Daru I-Badya wan dibari nama Casablanca ulih bubuhan padagang Spanyol nang mandiriakan markas pardagangan di sana.
hypothesis: Sultan Maroko mambangun ulang kota ngini sabagai Daru l-Badya wan diganalnya sabagai Casablanca ulih padagang Spanyol nang manubuhkan pangkalan dagang di sana.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: Casablanca ialah salah sabuting tampat paling rami gasan baulanja di saluruh Maroko.
hypothesis: Casablanca adalah salah satu tempat paling kada menarik gasan belanja di seluruh Maroko.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Di sakitar Medina tuha nyaman gasan manamuakan wadah-wadah nang manjual barang-barang tradisional Maroko, nang kaya tagine, tambikar, barang-barang kulit, hukah, wan bamacam-macam pernak-pernik, tatapi sabarataannya ngitu gasan turis.
hypothesis: Di sekitar Medina lawas mudah gasan manamuakan wadah manjual barang-barang tradisional Maroko, kaya tagine, keramik, barang kulit, hookah, wan seberataan spesies geegaw, tapi itu barataan gasan turis.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: Goma ialah kota wisata Republik Demokratik Kongo di hujung timur parak Rwanda.
hypothesis: Goma adalah sabuah kota wisata di Republik Demokratik Kongo di timur nang paling parak Rwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Tahun 2002, Goma hancur oleh lava yang asalnya dari Gunung Nyiragongo yang mangubur hampir samuaan jalanan, nang utamanya di pusat kuta.
hypothesis: Tahun 2002 Goma dihancurakan oleh lava dari gunung berapi Nyiragongo nang manyuburakan sebagian besar jalanan kota, khususnya pusat kota.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Samantara Goma cukup aman, satiap elangan di luar Goma harus ditaliti gasan mamahami kaadaan paparangan nang tajadi di provinsi Kivu Utara.
hypothesis: Samantaro Goma aman, parjalanan di lua Goma harus ditarimo untuak mangarati kondisi pajuangan nan taruih di provinsi Kivu Utara.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Kota nang ngini jua jadi pusko gasan naik ka gunung api Nyiragongo bedampingan jalan pandakian Gunung Gorila tamurah gasan di Afrika.
hypothesis: Kota ini jua adalah pangkalan gasan manjatuk gunung berapi Nyiragongo bersama beberapa gunung gorila paling murah di Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Pian kawa mamakai boda-boda (ojek) gasan bakuliling Goma. Haraga normal (lokal) ialah ~500 Franc Kongo gasan parjalanan nang handap.
hypothesis: Pian kawa mamakai boda-boda (taxi motor) gasan bajalan di Goma. Harga (lokal) normal adalah ~ 500 frank Kongo gasan perjalanan pendek.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Dihubungakan lawan kangalihan aksesnya, "Timbuktu" sudah dipakai sabagai metafora gasan eksotis, negeri-negeri nang jauh.
hypothesis: Digabung lawan ketidakpedulian relatifnya, "Timbuktu" sudah dipakai sebagai metafora gasan tanah eksotik, jauh.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Wayah ini, Timbuktu ialah kota nang miskin, maskipun reputasinya manjadiakannya wadah wisata, wan baisian bandara.
hypothesis: Wayah ini, Timbuktu adalah kota nang miskin, walaupun reputasinya maulah kota ngini jadi objek wisata, wan baisi bandara.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Pas tahun 1990, ngitu ditambahakan ka daftar situs warisan dunia nang dalam bahaya, maraga ancaman gurun pasir.
hypothesis: Tahun 1990, ngini ditambahakan ka daptar situs warisan dunia nang dalam bahaya, karana ancaman pasir gurun.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Ngini tu salah satu wadah basatup utama salawas Kaajaiban Dunia Afrika husus PBS Henry Louis Gates.
hypothesis: Itu adalah salah satu titik utama pas acara spesial PBS Henry Louis Gates' Wonders of the African World.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
hypothesis: Kota ini kada sama kaya kota-kota nang lain di nagara ini, karana lebih banyak bahasa Arab daripada bahasa Afrika.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Taman Nasional Kruger (TNK) andakannya di timur laut Afrika Selatan wan mambantang di sapanjang parbatasan Mozambik di timur, Zimbabwe di utara, wan parbatasan selatan ialah Sungai Buaya.
hypothesis: Taman Nasional Kruger (KNP) terletak di timur laut Afrika Selatan wan bajalan di sepanjang perbatasan Mozambik di timur, Zimbabwe di utara, wan perbatasan selatan adalah Sungai Krokodil.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Taman ngini mancakup 19.500 km² wan dibagi ka 14 wilayah ramah lingkungan nang balainan, masing-masing mandukung satwa liar nang balainan.
hypothesis: Taman ngini mancakup 19.500 km2 wan dibagi manjadi 14 ekozona nang balainan, masing-masing manantuakan satua liar nang balainan.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Ngini ialah salah satu atraksi utama Afrika Selatan wan ngini dianggap sabagai unggulan Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan (SANParks).
hypothesis: Ini adalah salah satu atraksi utama Afrika Selatan wan dianggap sabagai kapal induk Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Nang kaya sabarataan Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan, tadapat konserpasi harian wan biaya masuk gasan ka taman.
hypothesis: Nang kaya di barataan Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan, ada biaya konservasi wan masuk harian gasan taman.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Ngini mungkin juwa bamanfaat gasan sorang nang manukar sabuah Kartu Liar, nang manyadiakan akses masuk ka sabuting pilihan taman di Afrika Selatan atawa sabarataan Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan.
hypothesis: Bisa jua manuntungakan gasan saurang gasan manukar Wild Card, nang mambari akses ka salah satu pilihan taman di Afrika Selatan atawa ka sabarataan Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Pulau hong kong mambari wilayah hong kong ngarannya wan wilayah ini nang dianggap turis sabagai tujuan utama.
hypothesis: Pulau Hong Kong mambari ngaran wilayah Hong Kong wan adalah wadah nang banyak turis malihat sebagai fokus utamanya.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Parade gedung-gedung nang maolah cakrawala Hong Kong diibaratakan nang kaya diagram batang bakilauan nang diparlihatakan ulih kabaradaan banyu Palabuhan Victoria.
hypothesis: Parada bangunan nang manciptaakan garis langit Hong Kong sudah disamakan lawan bagan bar nang berkilau nang diulah jelas oleh adanya banyu Victoria Harbour.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Gasan mandapatakan pamandangan paling baik Hong Kong, tinggalakan pulau wan tulaklah ka tepi laut Kowloon di subarangnya.
hypothesis: Pian handak mandapatakan pandangan nang paling baik matan Hong Kong, bulik matan pulau wan bajalan ka pantai Kowloon di sabalah.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Sabahagian ganal pambangunan perkotaan Pulau Hong Kong padat di tanah reklamasi di sapanjang pantai utara.
hypothesis: Mayoritas pangembangan perkotaan Pulau Hong Kong banyak diisi di tanah nang diambil kembali di sepanjang pantai utara.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Ngini tu wadah nang diambil ulih panjajah Inggris sabagai ampun buhannya wan jadi lamun Pian mancari bukti masa lalu kolonial wilayah tarsabut, ngini tu wadah nang bagus gasan mamulai.
hypothesis: Ini adalah wadah nang diambil oleh penjajah Inggris sebagai miliknya wan jadi jika kau mencari bukti masa lalu kolonial wilayah ini, ini adalah tempat nang baik gasan mulai.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sundarbans ialah daerah pasisir bakau pangganalnya di dunia, mambantang 80 km (50 mil) ka daerah Banglades wan India daerah padalaman matan pasisir.
hypothesis: Sundarbans adalah sabuk mangrove pesisir terbesar di dunia, manjalakan 80 km (50 mil) ke pedalaman Bangladesh wan India dari pantai.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: Sundarbans sudah dinyataakan sabagai Situs Warisan Dunia UNESCO. Bagian hutan daerah India disambat Taman Nasional Sundarbans.
hypothesis: Sundarbans sudah diumumakan sabagai Situs Warisan Dunia UNESCO. Bagian hutan di dalam wilayah India disambat Taman Nasional Sundarbans.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Hutan-hutan kada baya rawa bakau — buhannya tamasuk babarapa sisa pahabisan matan hutan-hutan kuat nang suah manutupi daratan Gangga.
hypothesis: Hutan ngini kada hanya rawa mangrove tapi  inya tamasuk babarapa nang terakhir di hutan nang kuat nang pernah menutupi dataran Gangetic.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarbans malindungi sabuah daerah 3.850 km², nang sapar-tiganya ditukupi daerah-daerah banyu/rawa.
hypothesis: Sundarbans mancakup sabuting luas 3.850 km2, matan mana kira-kira satarluannya ditutupi di wilayah banyu/pasih.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Wayah tahun 1966 Sundarbans sudah manjadi sabuah parlindungan margasatwa, wan ngitu diparkirakan wayah ngini ada 400 harimau Karajaan Benggala wan sakitar 30.000 rusa tutul di daerah tasabut.
hypothesis: Sejak tahun 1966 Sundarbans sudah jadi wadah perlindungan satua liar, wan diukurakan wayah ini ada 400 harimau kerajaan Bengal wan sakitar 30.000 rusa nang batabut di daerah itu.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Bis-bis tasabut tulakan matan stasiun bis (malintasi sungai) sapanjang hari, maskipun sabagian ganal, tarutama nang manuju ka arah timur wan Jakar/Bumthang tulakan antara 06:30 wan 07:30.
hypothesis: Bus-bus nang maninggakan stasiun bus antar kabupaten (di seberang sungai) sepanjang hari, walaupun kebanyakan, terutama nang bajalan ka timur wan Jakar/Bumthang maninggakan antara 06:30 wan 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Karana bis-bis antar-daerah rancak hibak, dianjurakan gasan manukar sabuah teket babarapa hari sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Karana bas antar kabupaten rancak dipenuhi, disarankan gasan manukar tiket babarapa hari sabalumnya.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Kabanyakan daerah-daerah dilayani ulih bis-bis Coaster halus Jepang, nang nyaman wan kokoh.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan kabupaten dilayani oleh Bus Pantai Jepang halus, nang nyaman wan mantap.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Taksi pupuan ialah sabuah sarana nang lakas wan nyaman gasan manjalajahi ka wadah-wadah taparak, nang kaya Paro (Nu 150) wan Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Taxi nang dibagi adalah cara nang cepat wan nyaman gasan bajalanan ka tempat-tempat nang parak, kaya Paro (Nu 150) wan Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Jambatan Sungai Oyapock ialah jambatan gantung. Nang bentangan Sungai Oyapock nya gasan mahubungkan kota Oiapoque di Brazil wan Saint-Georges de l’Oyapock di Guyana Perancis.
hypothesis: Jembatan Sungai Oyapock adalah jembatan nang ditatap kabel. Jembatan ngini manjalang Sungai Oyapock gasan manyambungakan kota-kota Oiapoque di Brasil wan Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock di Guiana Prancis.

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Dua manara manjulang tinggi nya 83 meter, lalu 378 meter panjang nya wan bisi dua lajur nang lebarnya 3.50 meter.
hypothesis: Kadua menara maninggakan tinggi 83 meter, panjangnya 378 meter wan baisi dua jalur lebar 3,50 meter.

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: 15 meter badiri tagak di bawah jambatan nya. Bangunan nya tuntung pas Agustus 2011, kada kawa mambuka lalu lintas sampai Maret 2017.
hypothesis: Lempongan nang vertikal di bawah jembatan adalah 15 meter. Pambangunan sudah tuntung di bulan Agustus 2011, kada dibuka gasan lalu lintas sampai Maret 2017.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
reference: Dijadwalkan ni jambatan nya rasmi dipakai pas September 2017, pas wadah pamariksaan bea cukai Brazil nya parak tuntung.
hypothesis: Jembatan dijadwalkan akan beroperasi penuh pada bulan September 2017, pas titik-titik kontrol bea cukai Brasil diharapakan akan selesai.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Guaraní ialah kalompok adat nang hibak badiam jadi urang Paraguay Timur wayah ni, hidup semi-nomaden jadi pamburu nang jua manggarap lahan tani sekitarannya.
hypothesis: Urang Guaraní adalah kalompok adat nang paling penting nang manatap di mana wayah ini Paraguay Timur, hidup sabagai tukang buak semi-nomad nang jua bapraktik pertanian subsistence.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Daerah Chaco ialah rumah gasan kalompok adat nang lain jua temasuk Guaycurú wan Payaguá, nang betahan hidup nya dari beburu, bacocok tanam wan maunjun iwak.
hypothesis: Wilayah Chaco adalah wadah gasan kalompok-kalompok pribumi nang lain nang kaya urang Guaycurú wan Payaguá, nang hidup lawan mancing, maumpati wan mancing.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Pas abad ka-16 Paraguay, dahulunya disambat "Propinsi Raksasanya Hindia", lahir maraga batamunya bubuhan panguasa tanah Spanyol lawan kalumpuk suku asli.
hypothesis: Pas abad ka-16, Paraguay, nang sabalumnya disambat "Provinsi India Raya", lahir sebagai akibat dari pertemuan penakluk Spanyol lawan kelompok pribumi asli.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Urang Spanyol jua pamulaan masa panjajahan selawas tiga abad.
hypothesis: Urang Spanyol mamulai periode kolonialisasi nang berlangsung selama tiga abad.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Sudah dari didiriakannya kuta Asunción pas tahun 1537, Paraguay kawa mampartahanakan sipat asli wan kapribadiannya bubuhannya.
hypothesis: Sejak pandirian Asunción tahun 1537, Paraguay sudah berhasil mempertahankan banyak karakter wan identitas pribumi.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Argentina nang kita tahu bisi jua saikungan tim wan pemain polo tebaik sedunia.
hypothesis: Argentina terkenal banar lawan baisi salah satu tim polo nang paling baik wan pamain di dunia.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Lomba ganal nang saban tahun bulan Desember wadahnya di lapangan polo Las Cañitas.
hypothesis: Turnamen terbesar tahun ini diadakan di bulan Desember di lapangan polo di Las Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Lomba nang labih halus wan petandingannya kawa dijanaki sini di lain waktu saban tahun.
hypothesis: Turnamen dan pertandingan nang lebih halus jua kawa dilihat di sini pada waktu lain tahun.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Gasan habar lomba wan mana wadah manukari tiket lomba polo, pariksakan ke Asosiasi Polo Argentina.
hypothesis: Untuk berita tentang turnamen wan di mana gasan manukar tiket gasan pertandingan polo, lihat Asociación Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Mata uang rasmi nya Falkland ialah Pound Falkland (FKP) nang mata uangnya ni matan sama nilainya lawan satu Pound Inggris (GBP).
hypothesis: Mata uang resmi Falklands adalah pound Falkland (FKP) nang nilainya diatur setara lawan satu pound Inggris (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Duitnya kawa dihurupi di sauting-utingannya bank nang ada di pulau nang mana wadahnya di Stanley lewat dari toko FIC West.
hypothesis: Duit kawa ditukar di bank tunggal di pulau nang terletak di Stanley di sabalah ka sabalah ka toko FIC West.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Pound Inggris rajin jua kawa diterima dimana haja di sekitaran pulau lalu kartu kredit di Stanley wan Dollar AS masih kawa dipakai kadang jua.
hypothesis: Pound Inggris biasanya akan ditarima di mana-mana di pulau-pulau dan dalam kartu kredit Stanley dan dolar Amerika Serikat jua rancak ditarima.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Di sepalihan pulau nang tapancil bamacam-macam kartu kredit kada kawa diterima, biar mata uang Inggris wan Amerika Serikat kawa dibawai gin; takuni lawan ampunnya dulu gasan manantukan cara mambayar nang kawa diterima.
hypothesis: Di pulau-pulau nang jauh mungkin kadada kartu kredit nang ditarima, walaupun mata uang Inggris wan Amerika Serikat kawa diambil; pariksa lawan pamilik sabalumnya gasan manantuakan apa metode pambayaran nang kawa ditarima.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Handak kada mungkin jua amun bahurup mata uang Falklands diluar pulau tu, mata hurupi duitnya sabalum maninggalkan pulau.
hypothesis: Hampir kada mungkin gasan manukar mata uang Falklands di luar pulau-pulau, jadi tukar duit sabalum maninggalkan pulau-pulau.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Olehnya Montevideo di selatan Ekuator, ada musim panas nya amun lagi musim dingin di belahan bumi utara wan kabalikannya.
hypothesis: Karena Montevideo terletak di selatan khatulistiwa, musim panas di sana pas musim dingin di belahan bumi utara dan sebaliknya.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo ni subtropis; nang pas bulan musim panas nya rajin di atas +30°C.
hypothesis: Montevideo berada di daerah subtropis; pas bulan-bulan musim panas, suhu di atas +30°C rancak.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Musim dingin ni babujuran dingin: suhu tekadang bisa dibawah kadar mambaku nya, tapi jua angin wan lambab nya umpat tegabung jadi tarasa dingin bedasar ka termometer nya.
hypothesis: Musim dingin kawa dingin banar: suhu jarang turun di bawah titik beku, tagal angin wan kalembaban bagabung gasan maulah rasanya lebih dingin daripada apa nang dikataakan thermometer.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Kadada baistilah musim "pahujan" wan "kamarau": kadar hujannya kurang labih sama haja sapanjangan tahun.
hypothesis: Kadada musim "hujan" wan "hujan" khusus: jumlah hujan tatap sama sepanjang tahun.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Biar banyak hiwan-hiwan di taman sudah tabiasa malihat manusia, binatang liar tetap ai liar, kada bulih dibari makan atau dihaur.
hypothesis: Walaupun banyak binatang di taman ngini biasa melihat manusia, satua liar masih liar wan kada harus diakan atawa digangguakan.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Badasarkan pihak barwenang taman, badiam sakiranya 100 halaman/meter jauh matan baruang-baruang wan serigala-serigala wan 25 halaman/meter matan barataan hewan-hewan buas lainnya!
hypothesis: Manurut otoritas taman, tatap sekurang-kurangnya 100 yard/meter dari beruang wan serigala wan 25 yard/meter dari semua binatang liar lainnya!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Kada paduli kayapa bantukan buhannya, benteng, rusa, rusa ganal, baruang-baruang, wan sampai hewan-hewan lainnya kawa manyarang.
hypothesis: Apapun halusnya, bison, rusa, rusa, beruang, wan hampir sabarataan binatang ganal kawa manangani.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Satiap tahun, lusinan pangunjung tarluka karana buhannya kada manjaga jarak nang pas. Hewan-hewan ngini ganal, buas, wan bapotensi bahaya, jadi bari buhannya jarak.
hypothesis: Setiap tahun, puluhan pengunjung ta'alami luka karna kada manjaga jarak nang pas. Hewan ngini ganal, liar, wan berpotensi berbahaya, jadi berilah mereka ruang.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Gasan tambahan, waspadai lawan babauan manarik baruang-baruang wan satua buas lainnya, jadi hindari mambawa atau mamasak makanan nang bababu buruk wan jaga kabarsihan kemah.
hypothesis: Salain itu, ingatlah bahwa bau menarik beruang wan satua liar lainnya, jadi hindari mambawa atawa mamasak makanan nang bau wan jaga kemahnya bersih.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia ialah ibukota Samoa. Kota ngini barada di pulau Upolu wan bapanduduk di bawah 40.000 urang.
hypothesis: Apia adalah ibu kota Samoa. Kota ngini ada di pulau Upolu wan baisi populasi sakitar 40.000 urang.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia didirikan pada taun 1850-an wan ialah ibukota nagara Samoa waktu 1959.
hypothesis: Apia didiriakan pas tahun 1850an wan sudah jadi ibu kota rasmi Samoa sajak 1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Palabuhan ngitu ialah lukasi barlabuh angkatan laut nang terkenal di waktu 1889 wayah tujuh kelotok matan Jerman, AS, wan Inggris manolak maninggalakkan palabuhan.
hypothesis: Pelabuhan itu adalah wadah dari perang laut terkenal pada tahun 1889 pas tujuh kapal dari Jerman, AS, dan Inggris menolak meninggalkan pelabuhan.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Samuaan kapal tenggelam, kecuali satu kapal panjelajah Inggris. Parak 200 bubuhan wara Amerika wan Jerman meninggal.
hypothesis: Sabarataan kapal tabah, kecuali sabuting kapal pesiar Inggris. Hampir 200 nyawa Amerika wan Jerman hilang.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Wayah parjuangan gasan kamardekaan nang diadakan ulih pargerakan Mau, sabuah partemuan damai di kota manyababakan maninggalnya pamimpin paningginya Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
hypothesis: Sapanjang perjuangan kamardikaan nang diatur oleh gerakan Mau, pertemuan damai di kota itu mengakibatkan pembunuhan kepala utama Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Ada banyak pantai, olehnya Auckland ada di antara dua pelabuhan. Nang paling dipindandui urang ada tiga tempat.
hypothesis: Ada banyak pantai, karana Auckland dipasangi dua palabuhan. nang paling populer adalah di tiga daerah.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Pantai-pantai North Shore (di distrik North Harbor) ada di Samudra Pasifik wan memanjang dari Long Bay di Utara sampai Devonport di Selatan.
hypothesis: Pantai Pantai Utara (di distrik North Harbour) ada di Samudra Pasifik wan manjalang matan Long Bay di utara sampai Devonport di selatan.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Hampir seberataan pantai bepasir wan bakunyung nang aman, wan sebagian ganal beisi tempat naung nang disediaakan ulih pohon pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Hampir barataan pantai berpasir nang baisi kolam renang nang aman, wan sabagian ganal baisi bayangan nang disediakan ulih pohon pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pantai Tamaki Drive ada di Pelabuhan Waitemta, di pinggiran kota buhan kelas atas Mission Bay wan St Heliers di Auckland Tengah.
hypothesis: Pantai Tamaki Drive ada di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di pinggiran kota Mission Bay wan St Heliers di Auckland Tengah.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Ngini adalah pantai keluarga nang kadang-kadang ramai lawan banyak toko nang bejajar di pinggir pantai. Bakunyung itu aman.
hypothesis: Ini adalah pantai keluarga nang kadang-kadang banyak lawan banyak toko nang di pinggir pantai.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Bir lokal utamanya ialah 'Nomor satu', ngitu buan bir kompleks, tapi menghimungkan wan menyagarakan. Bir lokal lainnya disambat "Manta".
hypothesis: Bir utama lokal adalah 'Number One', ini kada bir nang kompleks, tapi nyaman wan segar. Bir lokal lainnya disambat "Manta".
