source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Ada banyak anggur Perancis nang musti dicuba, tapi anggur-anggur Selandia Baru wan Australia mungkin labih murah.
hypothesis: Ada banyak anggur Perancis nang kawa diinum, tapi anggur New Zealand wan Australia mungkin labih baik.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Banyu keran lokal ngitu aman gasan diminum, tapi banyu babotol sangat nyaman ditamukan lamun Pian takut.
hypothesis: Air keran lokal adalah aman banar gasan diminum, tapi banyu botol mudah ditamuakan bila kau takut.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Gasan buhan Australia, istilah "kopi susu" itu hal nang awam. Nang hitam halus ngini 'espresso', capuccino diapit lawan banyak krim (bukan busa), wan tih diulahi kada pakai susu.
hypothesis: Bagi urang Australia, gagasan kopi 'putih datar' adalah asing. Hitam pendek adalah 'espresso', cappuccino datang diumpulakan tinggi lawan krim (bukan busa), wan teh disajikan tanpa susu.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Cukelat panas ngitu disasuaikan lawan standar Belgia. Jus uah temahal tapi sangat nikmat.
hypothesis: Coklat panasnya sesuai lawan standar Belgia. jus buahnya mahal tapi manarik.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Hibak parjalanan ka karang ngitu diadakan sapanjang waktu, wan cidira nang disababkan ulih tarumbu karang ialah langa.
hypothesis: Banyak perjalanan ke terumbu dilakukan sepanjang tahun, wan cedera akibat salah satu dari penyebab ini di terumbu jarang.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Amun, dangarakan masukkan matan urang barwenang, patuhi samua tanda wan perhatiakan bujur-bujur paringatan kaselamatan.
hypothesis: Tapi, taruslah mamakai saran pamarintah, taat lawan samua tanda, wan taruslah mamakai peringatan keselamatan.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Ubur-ubur kutak ada di parak pantai wan sakitar muara sungai matan Oktober sampai April matan utara 1770. Buhannya kadang-kadang kawa ditamuakan di luar waktu-waktu ngini.
hypothesis: Kaduwa-kaduwa kotak tajadi di parak pantai wan parak estuari sungai matan bulan Oktober sampai April utara 1770.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Iwak hiu ngitu ada, tapi buhannya jarang manyarang manusia. Kabanyakan hiu takutan lawan manusia wan cagaran bajauh.
hypothesis: hiu ada, tapi jarang menyerang manusia. kebanyakan hiu takut lawan manusia dan akan berenang pergi.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Buaya muhara kada aktip manatap di laut, habitat utama buhannya ialah di muara sungai subalah utara Rockhampton.
hypothesis: Buaya banyu asin kada aktif hidup di samudra, habitat utamanya adalah di estuari sungai utara dari Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Mamasan badahulu mambari para pangunjung katanangan pikiran kalau buhannya cagar baisi wadah guring imbah buhannya sampai di tujuan buhannya.
hypothesis: Pemesanan sabalum mambari katenangan pikiran gasan palancong nang akan baisi wadah gasan tidur pas sampai di tujuan.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Nang bajualan tiket saring mampunyai kasepakatan lawan hotel tartentu, amun Pian kawa manamukannya gasan mamesan bantuk lain akumudasi, nang kaya wadah bakemah, malalui urang parjalanan.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan rancak baisi kesepakatan lawan hotel tertentu, walaupun kawa mandapatakan pemesanan bentuk lain dari akomodasi, kaya lapangan berkemah, melalui agen perjalanan.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Agen pajalanan biasanya manawarakan paket-paket nang sudah tamasuk makan pagi, akomodasi pajalanan ka/matan bandara atawa bahkan menggabungakan paket panerbangan wan hutel.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan biasanya menawarkan paket nang mencakup sarapan, pengaturan transportasi ke/dari bandara atawa bahkan paket penerbangan dan hotel gabungan.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Buhannya jua kawa manyimpankan reserpasi gasan Pian lamun Pian butuh waktu gasan memikirakan panawaran atawa manukar dukumen lain gasan tujuan Pian (nang kaya visa).
hypothesis: Buhannya jua kawa mamasukakan reservasi gasan Pian jika Pian mamarluakan waktu gasan bapikir akan tawaran atawa mandapatakan dokumen lain gasan tujuan Pian (misalnya visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Satiap parubahan atawa parmintaan amun harus dipadahi lawan nang bajual tiket tarlebih dahulu wan kada kawa langsung lawan hutel.
hypothesis: Namun, parubahan atawa parmintaan harus diulah melalui agen perjalanan terlebih dahulu dan kada langsung lawan hotel.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Sagan babarapa festival, Kabanyakan pasarta nang umpat festival musik mamutusakan bakemah di lokasi ngitu, wan Kabanyakan pasartanya jua maanggap itu sabagai pangalaman penting.
hypothesis: Di babarapa festival, mayoritas urang nang datang ka festival musik mamutusakan gasan bamacam di lokasi, wan kabanyakan urang nang datang malihatnya sabagai bagian penting dari pangalaman.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Amun pian handak parak lawan partunjukannya, Pian harus datang badahulu sagan mandapatakan lukasi bakemah nang parak lawan musik ngitu.
hypothesis: Amun handak parak lawan aksi, Pian harus datang awal gasan mandapatakan situs kamp parak lawan musik.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Musti diingat bahwa biar partunjukannya musik sudah tuntung di panggung utamanya, kamungkinan ada bagian festival nang tatap bamain musik sampai malam banar.
hypothesis: Ingat, walaupun musik di panggung utama mungkin sudah habis, mungkin ada bagian-bagian festival nang akan terus mamutar musik sampai malam.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Babarapa festival baisi area bakemah husus sagan kaluarga nang baisian kakanakan.
hypothesis: Babarapa festival baisi area khusus gasan berkemah gasan keluarga nang baisi anak halus.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Amun manyabrangi Baltik Utara di musim dingin, pariksa lokasi kabin dahulu, karna amun malewati es tu manyababakan kebisingan nang cukup mambari takutan sagan bubuhannya nang paling takan.
hypothesis: Amun manilang di Laut Baltik Utara pas musim dingin, pariksa lokasi kabin, karana manilang lewat es manyababakan bunyi nang cukup parah gasan nang paling bapengaruh.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Pas kapal-kapal pesiar Saint Petersburg mamasuki kota. Panumpang kapal pesiar dikecualiakan bagi nang baisian visa (pariksa ketentuannya).
hypothesis: Cruises Saint Petersburg mencakup waktu di kota. Penumpang cruise dikecualikan dari persyaratan visa (pariksa syarat-syaratnya).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Kasino-kasino biasanya menggawi banyak upaya sagan memaksimalakan waktu wan duit nang dihabisakan oleh bubuhan tamu. Lelongkang-lelongkang wan jam biasanya kadada, wan lawang sagan keluar ngalih didapatakan.
hypothesis: Kasinos biasanya maulah banyak upaya gasan manaksimalakan waktu wan duit nang dibelanjakan ulih tamu.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Bubuhannya biasanya beisi makanan khusus, minuman wan hiburan khusus, sagan manjaga suasana hati bubuhan tamu tetap bagus, wan manjaga buhannya tu tetap di tempatnya.
hypothesis: Biasanya inya baisi makanan, minuman wan hiburan nang istimewa, gasan manjaga tamu dalam suasana hati nang baik, wan manjaga mereka di premis.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Babarapa wadah manawarakan minuman baalkohol gratis. Tatapi, mabuk tu merusak penilaian, wan seberataan penjudi nang lihai harusnya tahu pantingnya sagan tatap hawas.
hypothesis: Babarapa wadah mamakai minuman beralkohol di rumah. Tapi, mabuk mangaruhi panghakiman, wan sabarataan pamain judi nang baik tahu pentingnya tatap sadar.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Siapa haja nang handak mengemudi di ketinggian atawa maliwati gunung harus mamirikirakan kamungkinan salju, es, atawa suhu nang liwar dingin atawa suhu beku.
hypothesis: Siapa haja nang handak bajalan di garis lintang tinggi atawa di atas gunung harus mempertimbangkan kemungkinan salju, es, atawa suhu dingin.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Di jalanan nang besalju wan ba es, gesekannya randah dan Pian kada kawa bila mangamudi kaya Pian pas mangamudi di aspal.
hypothesis: Di jalan-jalan nang ais wan salji, tarikan kurang wan Pian kada kawa mamandu kaya di atas aspal nang kosong.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Salawas badai salju, salju cukup meolah Pian tejebak wan kawa meolah Pian gugur bekajutan.
hypothesis: Pas badai salju, salju nang cukup gasan manatap kawa turun dalam waktu nang sangat singkat.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Visibilitas kawa jua dipisah ulih turunnya salju atawa ulih kondensasi atawa es disapion kandaraan.
hypothesis: Visibilitas jua kawa dibatasi oleh hujan salju atawa akibat kondensasi atawa es di jendela kendaraan.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Di sisi lain, kundisi ba es wan salju nurmal di banyak nagara, wan lalu lintas kadada taganggu sepanjangan tahun.
hypothesis: Di sisi lain, kondisi es wan salji adalah normal di banyak nagara, wan lalu lintas rancak tarus sepanjang tahun.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Sapari kira-kira ialah daya tarik pariwisata nang ganal di Afrika wan sorutan gasan banyak pangunjung.
hypothesis: Safaris mungkin adalah tarikan wisata nang paling ganal di Afrika wan titik sorak gasan banyak pengunjung.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Istilah sapari dalam pamakaian umum mangacu kapada parjalanan darat gasan malihat alam liar di Afrika nang luarbiasa, tarutama di sabana.
hypothesis: Istilah safari nang dipakai sacara umum marujuk pada perjalanan darat gasan malihat satua liar Afrika nang luar biasa, khususnya di savanna.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Sabagian hewan, nang kaya gajah wan jarapah, salalu parak ulih mutur wan paralatan satandar cagar mambariakan panglihatan nang bagus.
hypothesis: Babarapa binatang, kaya gajah wan jerapah, rancak parak lawan mobil wan alat standar akan mamungkinakan panampilan nang baik.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Singa, cheetah wan macan tutul takana-kana panyupan wan Pian pacang malihati inya labih bagus lawan binokular.
hypothesis: Singa, cheetah wan leopard kadang-kadang malu wan ikam akan malihatnya labih baik lawan binocular.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Sapari bajalan batis (jua disambat "jalan rumput", "mandaki sapari", atawa "babatis") tadiri matan mandaki, baik salawas babarapa jam atawa babarapa hari.
hypothesis: Safari jalan kaki (disambat jua "jalan di hutan", "jalan kaki", atawa "membangun") tadiri matan hiking, baik selama babarapa jam atawa babarapa hari.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Paralimpiade cagar diadaakan matan tanggal 24 Agustus sampai 5 September 2021. Babarapa partandingan cagaran diadaakan di wadah-wadah nang balainan di sabarataan Jepang.
hypothesis: Paralympics akan diadakan matan 24 Agustus sampai 5 September 2021. Babarapa acara akan diadakan di lokasi lain di saluruh Jepang.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo cagar manjadi sabuting kota di Asia nang manjadi tuan rumah pada Olimpiade musim panas, imbah manjadi tuan rumah pertandingan pada 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo akan jadi kota Asia haja nang sudah manarima dua Olimpiade musim panas, imbah manarima gamusnya pada tahun 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Amun pian mamasan panarbangan wan akomodasi sagan 2020 sabalum panundaan diumumakan, Pian kira-kira mamiliki situasi nang ngalih.
hypothesis: Amun Pian mambah penerbangan wan akomodasi Pian gasan tahun 2020 sabalum ditarbitakan penundaan, Pian mungkin baisi situasi nang ngalih.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Kabijakan pambatalan balain-lain, tatapi pada akhir Maret kabijakan pambatalan nang paling berbasiskan pada bulan Maret 2020, pas Olimpiade imbah dijadwalakan.
hypothesis: Kabijakan pembatalan bervariasi, tapi mulai akhir Maret sebagian besar kebijakan pembatalan berbasis virus corona tidak manjangka sampai Juli 2020, pas Olimpiade sudah dijadwalkan.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Diparkirakan bahwa sabagian besar tiket acara cagar mamakai duit antara ¥2,500 wan ¥130.000, lawan tiket khas nang duitnya sakitar ¥7.000.
hypothesis: Diperkirakan bahwa sebagian besar tiket acara akan menelan biaya antara ¥2,500 sampai ¥130,000, dengan tiket khas menelan biaya sekitar ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Manyetrika baju nang lambab kawa mambantu mangaringkan awak. Banyak hotel nang mamiliki papan satrika wan satrika tarsadia gasan pinjaman, lawan amunnya ada kada nang kadeda di ruangan tarsebut.
hypothesis: Pakaian nang basah kawa manolongnya mangering. Banyak hotel baisi papan besi wan papan pangaring nang kawa di pinjam, walaupun kada ada di kamar.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Amun satrikaan kadeda, atawa amun Pian kada katuju mamakai kaus batis basatrika, maka Pian kawa mancobai mamakai pangaring rambut, amunnya ada.
hypothesis: Amun kada ada besi, atawa amun kada katuju memakai kaus kaki nang diisi besi, maka kawa mancoba memakai pengering rambut, amun ada.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Bahati-hati sakira kain kada manjadi talalu panas (nang kawa manyebabkan panyusutan, atau dalam kasus ekstrim, scorch).
hypothesis: Hati-hati kada mambulih kain jadi panas banar (nang kawa manyababakan panyimpangan, atawa dalam kasus ekstrim, bakar).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Ada babarapa cara gasan manjarnihakan banyu, ada babarapa cara nang labih ampuh tahadap ancaman tatantu.
hypothesis: Ada cara nang balain gasan mamalihasi banyu, babarapa labih efektif lawan ancaman nang spesifik.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Di babarapa daerah nang manjarang banyu salawas samanit sudah cukup, di wadah lainnya babarapa manit lagi diparluakan.
hypothesis: Di babarapa daerah, banyu nang bakawan selama satu menit sudah cukup, di sabagian lain, banyu nang bakawan butuh beberapa menit.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Filter bavariasi dalam efektivitas, wan amun Pian baisi kaprihatinan, maka pian harus mampertimbangkan manukar banyu Pian dalam botol tatutup matan parusahaan takamuka.
hypothesis: Filter beda-beda efektifitasnya, wan amun ada masalah, maka sebaiknya kamu mempertimbangkan gasan manukar banyumu dalam botol nang dilampirakan dari parusahaan nang bajudul.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Buhan panjalanan kawa badapat hama hewan nang kada dipinandui di wadah asal Inya.
hypothesis: Pangunjung kawa ba'isi binatang-binatang nang kada ba'isi di wilayah asal buhannya.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Hama kawa marusak makanan, maulahi iritasi, atawa maulahi gatalan, mahambur wisa, wan mahambur infeksi.
hypothesis: Hama kawa mancuritakan makanan, manyababakan iritasi, atawa dalam kasus nang paling parah manyababakan reaksi alergi, manyebar racun, atawa manyebar infeksi.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Panyakit nang manjangkit, binatang babahaya nang kawa malukai atawa mamati'I manusia, ngitu kada kawa dipadahkan sabagai hama.
hypothesis: Penyakit infeksi itu sendiri, atawa binatang berbahaya nang kawa manyakiti atawa mambunuh manusia lawan paksa, biasanya kada layak sebagai hama.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Bebelanja duty free ngitu ialah pilawang gasan menukar barang-barang nang kada bepajak wan kada becukai di bebarapa tempat.
hypothesis: belanja bebas bea bea adalah kesempatan gasan manukar barang nang bebas pajak wan aksiz di lokasi tertentu.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Bubuhan pejalan jauh nang ketuju bejalan ke nagara lain nang pajaknya gonol bahanu kawa meimit duit nang banyak, amun kada tapi menukar minuman bealkohol wan timbaku.
hypothesis: Pelancong nang bajalanan ka nagara nang banyak pajak kadang-kadang kawa menabung duit nang cukup, terutama gasan produk kaya minuman beralkohol wan tembakau.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Di jalan nang bujur antara Point Marion wan Fairmont membari’i keadaan menyupir paling ngalih di jalan gonol Buffalo-Pittsburgh, sambil racap malalui pulau hutanan di pinggir jalan.
hypothesis: Jalur antara Point Marion wan Fairmont manunjukakan kondisi pengemudi nang paling menantang di jalan raya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, rancak melewati medan alas belakang terisolasi.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Amunnya kada tapi tebiasa menyupir di jalan kampung, beakal-akal haja melalui jalan mereng, kipit, wan tikungan patah nang diutamaakan.
hypothesis: Amun ikam kada biasa mambawa di jalan-jalan kampuang, hati-hati: garis-garis nang tegak, jalur-jalur nang sempit, wan kurva tajam nang dominan.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Batasan laju jalas talihat terandah di bagian nang tedudi wan nang cagaran datang ) — biasanya 35-40 mph (56-64 km/j) ) — wan nang pasti panting banar taat wan paraturannya.
hypothesis: Batas kacepetan nang ditampilakan labih rendah daripada di bagian sabalum wan sasuai  biasanya 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)  wan taat nang ketat wan ngitu labih penting daripada lain.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Tapi jua lah, anehnya nih, layanan telepon ganggam telaju di sini jaka dibandingakan wan di jalan-jalan lurus di rute nang lain, misalnya di Pennsylvania Wilds.
hypothesis: Namun, nang menariknya, layanan telepon seluler jauh lebih kuat di sini daripada di sepanjang banyak garis lain dari rute, misalnya Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Wadai-wadai di Jarman cukup nyaman, wan di Bayern, cukup banyak wan bamacam-macam, mahirip lawan ampun tatangga buhannya, di Austria bagian salatan.
hypothesis: Kue Jerman cukup baik, dan di Bavaria, cukup kaya dan beragam, mirip lawan tetangga selatan, Austria.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Wadai olahan buah ialah umumnya lawan apel dimasak ke bulatan pas tahun pastry, wan ceri wan plums maolah penampilan gasan salama musim panas.
hypothesis: Kue buah rancak, lawan apel dimasak jadi kue sepanjang tahun, wan ceri wan prun muncul pas musim panas.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Banyak makanan panggangan di Jarman jua manampilkan kacang almond, hazelnut, wan kacang pohon wan lainnya. Wadai-wadai nang tarkanal karancakannya dipasangakan cukup baik lawan sacangkir kopi nang kuat.
hypothesis: Banyak makanan bakar Jerman jua mamakai almond, hazelnut, wan kacang pokok lainnya.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Amun Pian handak babarapa wadai bamacam-macam biarnya halus, ngini targantung di daerah nang disebut Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.
hypothesis: Amun ikam handak bakery halus tapi kaya, coba apa nang tagantung lawan wilayahnya disambat Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Karih ialah makanan nang bahan dasarnya ngitu rampah-rampah, lawan daging atawa sayuran.
hypothesis: Curry adalah hidangan nang tadiri matan ramuan wan rempah, babarapa lawan daging atawa sayuran.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Karih kawa "karing" atau "basah" tagantung jumlah kuahnya.
hypothesis: Curry kawa "garing" atawa "lemak" tagantung lawan jumlah cairan.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: Di dairah-dairah padalaman India Utara wan Pakistan, yoghurt biasa dipakai dalam karih; di India Selatan wan babarapa daerah pantai lainnya di anak banua ngini, santan biasanya dipakai.
hypothesis: Di wilayah pedalaman India Utara wan Pakistan, yogurt rancak dipakai dalam kari; di India Salatan wan babarapa wilayah pesisir lainnya di subkontinent, susu kelapa rancak dipakai.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Lawan 17.000 pulau gasan dipilih, makanan Indonesia ialah astilah nang mamayungi wan meliputi ragam masakan regional nang banyak didapati di sabarataan nageri.
hypothesis: Dengan 17.000 pulau nang kawa dipilih, makanan Indonesia adalah istilah umbrella nang mencakup bamacam masakan daerah nang ada di saluruh nagara.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Tatapi, amun dipakai kada lawan kualifikasi labih lanjut, astilah tarsebut karancakan bararti makanan nang berasal dari bagian tangah wan timur dari pulau utama Jawa.
hypothesis: Tapi, bila dipakai tanpa kualifikasi lain, istilah ngini biasonyo mangartiakan makanan nang asalnya matan bagian tangah wan timur pulau utama Jawa.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Nang ngini sudah tasadia sacara luas di sabarataan kapulauan, masakan Jawa manampaiakan bamacam masakan nang kaya lawan bumbu, bumbu predominan nang dikatujui urang Jawa ialah kacang, lumbuk, gula (tarutama gula nyiur Jawa) wan bamacam bumbu arumatik.
hypothesis: Kini banyak dihandaki di seluruh kepulauan, masakan Jawa baisi sajumlah hidangan nang hanya dimasak, rasa utama nang disukai urang Jawa adalah kacang tanah, chiles, gula (apalagi gula kelapa Jawa) wan macam-macam rempah-rempah aromatik.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Stirrups mandukung gasan batis pangandara nang bagantung ka kadua sisi pelana.
hypothesis: Stirrups adalah dukungan gasan kaki pengendara nang gantung di kedua sisi sela.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Buhannya mambari stabilitas nang labih ganal gasan pangandara tapinya juwa hingkat baisi parhatian wan kasalamatan karana putensi lawan batis saurang pangandara gasan kada tapajal di dalamnya.
hypothesis: Buhannya mambari stabilitas nang labih tinggi gasan pengendara tapi kawa baisi masalah keselamatan karana potensi kaki pengendara jadi terjebak di buhannya.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Amun saurang panunggang tagugur matan kuda tatapi batis takait dalam sanggurdi, inya bisa taseret amun kuda bukah. lawan maminimalkan risiko ngini, dipakai sejumlah pangamanan.
hypothesis: Amun urang nang ba'aling dibalangi matan kuda tapi batisnya kada ba'aling, kuda itu kawa taringgang.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Pamulaan, kabanyakan pembalap tu mamakai sapatu but halus nang pas lawan tumit, cukup sempit, wan sole.
hypothesis: Pertama, kebanyakan pengendara memakai sepatu kemudi nang baisi tumit wan tungkai halus, nang cukup sempit.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Salanjutnya, babearapa sadel, khususnya sadel Inggris, baisi bar pangaman nang mamungkinkan kulit stirrup gugur matan pelana amun ditarik mundur uleh pambalap nang gugur.
hypothesis: Salain itu, babarapa kursi, khususnya kursi Inggris, baisi bar keselamatan nang mamungkinakan kulit stirrup jatuh dari kursi jika ditarik ke belakang oleh panunggang nang jatuh.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Cochamó Valley - Tujuan panaikan pamulaan Chili, dikanal sabagai Yosemite matan Amerika Salatan, lawan bamacam dinding wan tabing granit ganal.
hypothesis: Lembah Cochamó - tujuan pendakian utama Chili, nang dikenal sabagai Yosemite di Amerika Selatan, lawan beragam dinding granit ganal wan batuan.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Puncak gunung itu tamasuk pamandangan nang luar biasa dari atas. Pandaki matan bamacam balahan dunia rancak maulah jalan hanyar di sala putensi dinding nang kada tahingga.
hypothesis: Pamungutan puncak mencakup pandangan nang manarik nafas dari puncak. pendaki dari seluruh belahan dunia terus-menerus meulah rute baru di antara potensi tembok nang kada habis.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Downhill snowsports, mancakup ski wan snowboarding, ialah ulahraga tarkanal nang malibatkan ski atawa papan salju nang maluncur ka bawah barikit dibatis pian tatutup wan salju.
hypothesis: Olahraga salju turun bukit, nang tamasuk ski wan snowboard, adalah olahraga nang populer nang melibatkan meluncur turun di tanah nang ditutupi salju lawan ski atawa snowboard nang ditambat ka kaki.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Ski ialah kagiatan wisata ganal lawan banyak peminat, rancak dikiau "galandangan ski," nang marancanakan sapanjangan paraian gasan main ski di suatu tampat tartantu.
hypothesis: Ski adalah kegiatan wisata utama lawan banyak penggemar, kadang-kadang dikenal sabagai "ski bums", nang mamancanaakan liburan keseluruhan di sekitar ski di lokasi tertentu.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Pamikiran ba ski sudah lawas banar — gambaran di guha menggambarkan pamain ski sejak tahun 5000 SM!
hypothesis: Gagasan ski adalah lukisan gua nang lawas banar nang manunjukakan skier sudah ada sejak tahun 5000 SM!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Olahraga Ski kambali menurun satidaknya sampai abad ka-17, pas tahun 1861 klub ski rekreasi parmulaan dibuka uleh urang Norwegia di Australia.
hypothesis: Ski bawah sebagai olahraga dimulai paling kada abad ka-17, wan pas tahun 1861 klub ski rekreasi pertama dibuka oleh Norwegia di Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Wisata lawan ba ski: Kagiatan ngini juwa disambat backcountry ski, ski touring atawa ski hiking.
hypothesis: Backpacking dengan ski: Kegiatan ngini disambat jua backcountry ski, ski touring atawa ski hiking.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Hal ngini saling barkaitan tatapi kada melibatkan gaya alpine ski touring atawa mountaineering, lawan nang terakhir dilakukan di daerah curam wan mambutuhkan banyak skis stiffer wan sepatu but.
hypothesis: Ini bahubungan lawan tapi biasanya kada melibatkan tur ski atau pendakian gunung gaya alpine, nang terakhir dilakukan di medan curam wan mamarluakan ski wan sepatu nang jauh lebih kaku.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Pikirakan rute ski sabagai rute hiking sarupa.
hypothesis: Pikirakan rute ski sabagai rute hiking nang mirip.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Dalam kundisi nang bagus pian pacang kawa manampuh jalan nang pina tajauh daripada bajalan – tatapi hanya sasakali pian pacang mendapatkan kalajuan ski lintas country kada pakai tas barat di trek groomed.
hypothesis: Dalam kondisi nang baik ikam kawa manempuh jarak nang labih ganal daripada bajalan  tapi hanya jarang haja ikam kawa mandapatakan kacepetan ski lintas tanah tanpa tas ransel nang berat di jalur nang sudah disaring.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Eropa ialah banua nang pina halus tapi baisian banyak nagara mardika. Dalam kaadaan nurmal, bajalanan maliwati babarapa nagara harus maliwati aplikasi visa wan pamariksaan paspur batarusan.
hypothesis: Eropa adalah benua nang relatif halus tapi baisi banyak nagara independen. Di bawah keadaan normal, bajalanan malalui banyak nagara mamakai parmintaan visa wan pariksa paspor berkali-kali.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Zona Schengen, kaya apa ja, bagawi pina kaya sa nagara dalam hal ini.
hypothesis: Zona Schengen, bagaimanapun, bagawi kaya satu nagara dalam hal ngini.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Salawas Pian ada di wilayah ini, Pian biasanya kawa maliwati parbatasan maski kada liwat wadah pamariksaan paspur lagi.
hypothesis: Selama ikam tinggal di zona ini, ikam kawa malalui batas tanpa ma'lampaui kontrol paspor lagi.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Nang kaya itu jua, apabila baisian visa Schengen, Pian kada parlu maunjuk visa ka masing-masing nagara angguta Schengen sacara tapisah, sahingga maimit waktu, duit wan barkas.
hypothesis: Nang kaya itu, lawan baisi visa Schengen, Pian kada parlu maminta visa gasan masing-masing nagara anggota Schengen secara terpisah, maka manjimatkan waktu, duit wan karjanya.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Kadada katantuan samesta nang dapat dipakai gasan barang nang diproduksi sabagai barang antik. Babarapa instansi pajak manetapakan barang-barang nang lawas matan 100 tahun sabagai barang antik.
hypothesis: Kadada definisi universal gasan barang-barang nang diulah adalah barang antik. Babarapa agensi pajak mangarti barang-barang nang labih lawas dari 100 tahun sabagai barang antik.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Definisi ngini bisi bemacam geograpis, nang mana batas umur mungkin tapendek di wadah kaya Amerika Utama matanpada di Eropa.
hypothesis: Definisi ngini baisi variasi geografis, di mana batas umur mungkin labih pendek di tempat-tempat nang kaya Amerika Utara daripada di Eropa.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Produk-produk ulahan tangan kawa ditantukan sabagai barang antik, maskipun teanum matanpada barang produksi masal nang sama.
hypothesis: Produk kerajinan bisa didefinisikan sebagai barang antik, meskipun lebih muda daripada barang produksi massal nang serupa.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Patarnakan rusa jadi gawian utama urang-urang suku Sámi wan budaya disakitaran masalah pardagangan panting jua gasan gawian nang lain.
hypothesis: Pambudayaan rusa adalah sarana hidup penting di antara urang Sami wan budaya nang mengelilingi perdagangan ini penting jua gasan banyak nang baisi profesi lain.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Maskipun sacara tradisional, kada barataan Sami manggawi patarnakan rusa kutub ukuran ganal, tatapi hidup matan maunjun, barburu wan samiripnya, bisi rusa kutub kabanyakan dijadiakan hiwan panarik barang.
hypothesis: Bahkan secara tradisional, walaupun, kada sabarataan Sami sudah terlibat dalam peternakan rusa skala besar, tapi hidup dari mancing, berburu wan sejenisnya, baisi rusa terutama sebagai binatang draft.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Wayah ngini Sami begawi di pardagangan moderen. Pariwisata ialah pakolehan panting di Sapmi, wilayah Sami.
hypothesis: Hari ini banyak urang Sami bagawi dalam bisnis modern. Pariwisata adalah pendapatan penting di Sápmi, daerah Sami.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Maskipun banyak dipakai, tautama di antara non-Romani, kata "Gipsi" ialah biasa dicap hina karana raitannya wan steriotip negatip wan panglihatan nang kada sasuai matan urang-urang Romani.
hypothesis: Walaupun ngini dipakai sacara luas, tarutama di kalangan non-Romani, kata "Gypsy" rancak dianggap manyalahi karana asosiasi lawan stereotip negatif wan persepsi kada akurat tentang urang Roma.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Lamun nagara nang akan Pian elangi manjadi sabuah subjek laporan parjalanan, asuransi parjalanan kasehatan Pian atau asuransi pambatalan parjalanan Pian bisa barpangaruh.
hypothesis: Amun nagara nang Pian akan bajalanan jadi bahan saran perjalanan, asuransi kesehatan perjalanan Pian atawa asuransi pembatalan perjalanan Pian kawa dipengaruhi.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Pian jua mungkin handak barkonsultasi lawan pamarintah salain pamarintah pian saurang, tapi saran buhannya diulah gasan warga nagara buhannya.
hypothesis: Pian mungkin handak jua maminta saran pamarintah lain, tapi saran nang digunakannya gasan warganya.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Sabagai sabuting cuntuh, warga Amerika di Timur Tengah mungkin mahadapi situasi nang babeda matan urang Eropa wan Arab.
hypothesis: Sebagai contoh, warga Amerika di Timur Tengah mungkin menghadapi situasi nang berbeda lawan urang Eropa atawa Arab.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Panasehat baya ringkasan singkat matan kaadaan politik di sabuting nagara.
hypothesis: Saran hanyalah ringkasan singkat tentang situasi politik di satu negara.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Pamandangan nang dihadirakan saringkali barsipat sapintas, umum wan telalu biasa ditandingakan lawan inpormasi nang labih rinci nang ada di wadah lain.
hypothesis: Pandangan nang dipresentasikan rancaknya kada jelas, umum wan terlalu disederhanakan dibandingakan lawan informasi nang labih rinci nang ada di tempat lain.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
reference: Cuaca nang karas ialah istilah umum gasan satiap penomena cuaca nang babahaya lawan potensi manyababkan kahancuran, hauran sosial nang serius, atau hilangnya nyawa urang.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah adalah istilah umum gasan fenomena cuaca berbahaya nang berpotensi manyababakan karusakan, gangguan sosial nang serius, atawa hilangnya nyawa manusia.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Cuaca buruk kawa tarjadi di mana ja di dunia, wan ada bamacam tipenya, nang di mana bisa bagantung pada kondisi geograpi, topograpi, wan atmosfer.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah kawa tajadi di mana haja di dunia, wan ada macam-macamnya, nang kawa bergantung pada geografi, topografi, wan kondisi atmosfer.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Angin kancang, hujan es, hujan labat nang balabihan, wan kagusangan hutan ialah bentuk wan epek matan cuaca nang parah, kaya badai peter, angin ribut, samburan banyu, wan angin topan.
hypothesis: Angin nang kuat, hujan es, hujan nang berlebihan, wan kebakaran hutan adalah bentuk wan efek cuaca nang parah, kaya badai badai, tornado, air tumpah, wan badai.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Penomena cuara buruk daerah wan musiman tamasuk hujan salju, badai salju, badai es, wan badai debu.
hypothesis: Fenomena cuaca parah daerah wan musiman tamasuk badai salju, badai salju, badai es, wan badai debu.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Wisatawan disarankan banar gasan manyadari risiko cuaca buruk nang manyababkan wilayah buhannya karana cuacanya bisa mampangaruhi rancana parjalanan.
hypothesis: Pelancong disarankan banar untuk sadar akan bahaya cuaca parah nang mempengaruhi wilayah mereka karena mungkin mempengaruhi rencana perjalanan.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Siapa haja nang pacangan bejalanan ka nagara nang bisa dianggap sabagai wilayah parang musti mandapat palatihan ahli.
hypothesis: Siapa haja nang handak manimbau ka nagara nang kawa dianggap sabagai zona perang harus mandapek pelatihan profesional.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Sabuah pancarian di Internet gasan 'Kursus Lingkungan nang Bamusuhan' kamungkinan akan mambariakan alamat sabuah parusahaan lokal.
hypothesis: Pancarian di Internet gasan 'kursus lingkungan musuh' mungkin akan mandapatakan alamat parusahaan lokal.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Sabuah kursus biasanya akan mancakup barataan isu nang dibahas di sini jauh labih rinci, biasanya lawan pangalaman praktis.
hypothesis: Kursus biasanya akan mencakup semua isu-isu yang dibahas di sini dengan lebih rinci, biasanya dengan pengalaman praktis.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Sabuah kursus biasanya akan barlangsung selawas 2-5 hari wan akan malibatakan pamainan peran, banyak bantuan partama wan kadang-kadang palatihan sanjata-sanjata.
hypothesis: Kursus biasanya akan dari 2-5 hari dan akan melibatkan permainan peran, banyak bantuan pertama dan kadang-kadang latihan senjata.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Buku-buku wan majalah-majalah nang baurusan lawan kabarlangsungan hidup hutan balantara ialah hal biasa, tatapi panarbitan-panarbitan nang baurusan lawan zona perang masih sadikit.
hypothesis: Buku wan majalah nang bapadah lawan kelangsungan hidup di padang gurun rancak, tagal publikasi nang bapadah lawan daerah perang jarang.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Palayar-palayar nang baistilah panugasan operasi jenis kelamin beasa di luar negeri musti manahapakan buhannya mambawa dokumen nang bujur gasan parjalanan bulik.
hypothesis: Penumpang nang handak mamindahakan seks di luar negeri harus memastikan bahwa mereka membawa dokumen nang sah gasan perjalanan pulang.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Kasadiaan pamarintah mangaluarakan paspor lawan janis kalamin kada dinyatakan (X) atawa membaiki dokumen agar sasuai lawan ngaran nang diinginakan wan macam janis kalamin.
hypothesis: Keinginan pamarintah gasan mangaluarakan paspor nang kadada gender nang diartiakan (X) atawa dokumen nang diupdate gasan maumpati ngaran wan gender nang dikhandaki.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Kasadiaan pamarintah asing gasan manghormati dokumen-dokumen ngini jua sangat bamacam-macam.
hypothesis: Keinginan pamarintah asing gasan manhormati dokumen nginih sama ganal bervariasi.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Pamariksaan di pos kaamanan jua jadi manggangu banar masa sasudah -11 September 2001.
hypothesis: Penelusuran di pos pemeriksaan keamanan jua jadi jauh lebih mengganggu di era pasca 11 September 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Urang-urang sabalum operasi transgender kada bulih baharap gasan maliwati alat-alat pamindai lawan privasi wan martabat buhannya utuh.
hypothesis: Transgender pra-operatif kada kawa mananti gasan melewati scan lawan privasi wan martabatnya kada rusak.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Arus pacah ialah aliran nang mangalir balik matan galombang nang mamecah di pantai, sering kali di sabuah karang atawa nang tamirip.
hypothesis: Garis-garis ripp adalah aliran pulang matan ombak nang pecah dari pantai, rancak di karang atawa sarupa.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Karana topologi bawah banyu aliran balik tapusat pada babarapa bagian nang labih dalam, wan arus capat ka dalam banyu mungkin tabantuk di sana.
hypothesis: Karena topologi bawah banyu aliran balik dikonsentrasi di beberapa bagian nang labih dalam, wan arus cepat ke banyu dalam kawa terbentuk di sana.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Kabanyakan kamatian disabapakan kauyuhan gegara bausaha bakuyung bulik malawan arus, nang pinanya mustahil.
hypothesis: Kebanyakan kematian terjadi akibat kelelahan mencoba berenang kembali lawan arus, nang mungkin kada mungkin.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Sagara satalah Pian kaluar matan arus, bakunyung balik kada labih ngalih matanpada biasanya.
hypothesis: Pas kau sudah keluar dari arus, berenang kembali tidak lebih sulit daripada biasanya.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Cuba arahakan ka suatu wadah di mana Pian kada tatangkap lagi atawa, tagantung lawan kamampuan Pian wan kalau pian sudah talihat, pian baik mahadang partulungan.
hypothesis: Cobalah manatap ka wadah nang kada kawa dicatat lagi atawa, tagantung lawan kaahlian Pian wan apakah Pian sudah dicatat, Pian mungkin handak mananti gasan disalurkan.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Membuliki adat jauh lebih mengajuti daripada adat yang datang sebelumnya (labih sedikitnya fase bulan madu), labih lawas, labih bangat.
hypothesis: Guncangan masuk pulang datang lebih awal daripada guncangan budaya (ada kurang fase bulan madu), bertahan lebih lama, dan bisa jadi lebih parah.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Wisatawan nang gampang menyesuaikan diri wan budaya hanyar kadang–kadang kangalihan marasuk budayanya sorang.
hypothesis: Pelancong nang mudah baadaptasi lawan budaya hanyar kadang-kadang ngalih banar baadaptasi lawan budaya asli.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Wayah hanyar bulik dari luar negeri, pian biasanya sudah balajar budaya hanyar lalu kahilangan beberapa budaya asal sorang.
hypothesis: Pas pulang pulang imbah hidup di luar negeri, ikam sudah maadaptasi lawan budaya hanyar wan hilang babarapa kabiasaan ikam matan budaya asalmu.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Wayah pemulaan hidup di luar negeri, biasanya urang-urang paham haja mun wisatawan masuk ke nagara hanyar tuh perlu adaptasi.
hypothesis: Pas kamu pertama kali ke luar negeri, urang mungkin sabar wan paham, tahu bahwa wisatawan di negara baru harus beradaptasi.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Urang banyak kada besiap kalau sabar wan pangartian ngitu perlu gasan wisatawan bulik ka rumah.
hypothesis: Urang mungkin kada mamprediksi bahwa sabaratan wan pangatahuan jua parlu gasan wisatawan pulang.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Partunjukkan suara wan lampu piramid ialah salah satu hal nang paling manarik di sini gasan kakanakan.
hypothesis: Pameran suara wan cahaya piramida adalah salah satu hal nang paling menarik di daerah ini gasan kakanakan.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Pian kawa malihati piramidanya pas malam wan Pian kawa malihatinya pas sunyi sabalum mulai pamintasan.
hypothesis: Pian kawa malihat piramida di gelap wan kawa malihatnya dalam diam sabalum acara dimulai.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Rancak tu Pian kawa mandangar suara buhan turis wan padagang. Kesah suara wan cahaya nang kaya di buku kesah.
hypothesis: Biasanya kau selalu ada disini suara wisatawan dan vendor kisah suara dan cahaya tuh kayak buku cerita

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx dijadiakan gasan latar belakang wan tukang kesah nang kesah nang panjang.
hypothesis: Sphinx diatur sabagai latar belakang wan narator kisah panjang.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Adigannya ditampilakan di piramidanya wan piramida nang balain umpatan banyala.
hypothesis: Adegan ditampilkan di piramida wan piramida nang balainan dibari cahaya.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Kapulauan Shetland Selatan, ditamuakan pada tahun 1819, diakui lawan babarapa nagara wan baisi pangkalan pambanyaknya, ada anam balas nang aktip pas tahun 2020.
hypothesis: Kapulauan Shetland Selatan, nang ditamuakan pas tahun 1819, diklaim oleh babarapa nagara wan baisi pangkalan paling banyak, lawan enam belas aktif pas tahun 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Kapulauan ngini andakannya 120 km di utara Samananjung. Nang paling ganal yato Pulau King George lawan wadah pamukiman Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: Nusantara ini terletak 120 km utara dari Semenanjung. Nang paling ganal adalah Pulau Raja George lawan pemukiman Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Pulau lainnya tamasuk Pulau Livingston, wan Pulau Deception nang mana kawah gunung barapi nang masih aktip manyadiaakan palabuhan alami nang bagus banar.
hypothesis: Lainnya tamasuk Pulau Livingston, wan Deception nang di mana caldera banjir gunung berapi nang masih aktif mambari palabuhan alam nang spektakuler.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: Tanah Ellsworth ngitu daerah di subalah salatan Samananjung, dibatasi lawan Laut Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Tanah Ellsworth adalah wilayah di selatan Semenanjung, dibatas ulih Laut Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Pagunungan di Samananjung ngini manyatu lawan dataran tinggi, imbah tu mancungul ba’asa maulah 360 km rantaian Pagunungan Ellsworth, nang dibalah lawan Glasier Minnesota.
hypothesis: Gunung-gunung di Semenanjung di sini bergabung ke dalam dataran tinggi, lalu muncul kembali gasan membentuk rantai 360 km Gunung Ellsworth, dipisah oleh gletser Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Bagian utara atawa Sentinel Range baisi gunung paningginya di Antartika, yato Vinson Massif, Gunung Vinson nang tingginya 4892 m.
hypothesis: Bagian utara atawa Sentinel Range baisi gunung tertinggi di Antartika, Vinson Massif, nang mancapai puncak di 4892 m Gunung Vinson.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Di wadah padalaman, nang kadada jangkauan talipun, talipun satelit bisa jadi sabubutingannya pilihan.
hypothesis: Di daerah nang jauh, tanpa sinyal telepon seluler, telepon satelit mungkin satu-satunya pilihanmu.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Talipun satelit lain gasan pangganti talipun silulir, Pian musti baraada di luar ruangan wan di wadah nang jalas tajangkau satelit gasan manalipun.
hypothesis: Telepon satelit umumnya kada menggantiakan telepon seluler, karena Pian harus di luar wan garis pandang jelas ke satelit gasan mamakai telepon.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Layanan ngini rancak dipakai lawan parusahaan pangiriman, tarmasuk kapal pasiar wan pangiriman barang nang mamarluakan data wan suara jarak jauh.
hypothesis: Layanan ini rancak dipakai oleh kapal, tamasuk kapal-kapal hiburan, serta ekspedisi nang baisi data jarak jauh wan kabutuhan suara.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Panyadia layanan talipun Pian musti kawa mambari tahu pasal manyambungakan ka layanan ngitu.
hypothesis: Panyadia layanan telepon lokal Pian harus kawa manyadiaakan informasi labih lanjut tentang manhubungakan lawan layanan ngini.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Pilihan ngini magin manjadi labih tarkanal gasan buhannya nang cagaran bahalat-tahun gasan batulakan wan balajar.
hypothesis: Pilihan nang taruih jadi populer gasan urang nang baulah tahun gap adalah bajalanan wan belajar.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Parihal ngini hususnya tarkanal gasan buhan palajar nang handak kuliah, nang mambariakan buhannya gasan maambil waktu satahun sabalum kuliah, kada parlu maninggalakan pandidikan buhannya.
hypothesis: Hal ngini hususnya populer lawan urang nang maninggalkan sekolah, nang mamungkinakan buhannya maambil satu tahun sebelum kuliah, tanpa mampromosi pendidikan buhannya.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Kabanyakannya tu, mandaptar gasan balajar pas mehalat-tahun di luar negeri sebujurnya kawa maningkatakan kasampatan Pian gasan pindah ka pandidikan nang tatinggi di negara asal Pian.
hypothesis: Dalam banyak kasus, manulisakan diri gasan kursus tahun-tahun gap di luar negeri bujur-bujur bisa maningkatakan kamungkinan Pian gasan pindah ke pendidikan tinggi di negara asal Pian.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Rancak tu cagar ada ungkus kuliah gasan mendaptar prugram-prugram pandidikan.
hypothesis: Biasanya akan ada biaya kuliah gasan mendaftar dalam program pendidikan ini.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Finlandia adalah tujuan gasan bejukung nang bagus. “Negeri Saribu Danau” jua beisi ribuan pulau, danau wan kepulauan pesisir.
hypothesis: Finlandia adalah tujuan kapal nang hebat. "Tanah seribu danau" baisi ribuan pulau jua, di danau wan di kapulauan pesisir.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Di kapulauan wan danau Pian kada perlu kapal pesiar.
hypothesis: Di nusantara wan tasik kada parlu lagi babuat kapal.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Walaupun kepulauan bagian pesisir wan danau nang paling ganal dasar cukup ganal gasan pesiar napa pun, kelotok nang halusan lagi atawa jukung menawari akan pengalaman nang beda.
hypothesis: Walaupun kapulauan pesisir wan tasik ganal bujur-bujur ganal gasan kapal pesiar, kapal-kapal halus atawa kayak jua menawarkan pengalaman nang lain.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Bejukung adalah hobi nasional di Finlandia, lawan jukung gasan setiap tujuh atawa delapan urang.
hypothesis: Pembahu adalah hobi nasional di Finlandia, lawan kapal gasan satiap tujuh atawa walopun urang.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Ngini cocok gasan Norwegia, Swedia wan New Zealand, tapi kebalikannya cukup unik (misalnya gasan di Belanda angkanya satu banding empat puluh).
hypothesis: Ini dipasangi oleh Norwegia, Swedia wan Selandia Baru, tapi lain-lain cukup unik (misalnya di Walanda angka adalah satu sampai ampat puluh).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Kabanyakan bamacam-macam Kapal Pasiar Baltic manawarakan singgah balawas di St. Pettersburg, Rusia.
hypothesis: Kebanyakan kapal pesiar Baltic nang berbeda baisi parjalanan panjang di St. Petersburg, Rusia.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Ngini ba’arti Pian kawa baelang ka kota barsajarah gasan babarapa hari, sasambilan babulik wan guringan di kapal pas malam.
hypothesis: Nang artinya Pian kawa manamu kota bersejarah gasan babarapa hari penuh sambil pulang wan bamalam di kapal wayah malam.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Mun Pian baya tulak ka darat mamakai kapal wisata, Pian kada parlu visa nang balain (mulai 2009).
hypothesis: Amun ikam hanya bajalan ka darat pakai kapal, Pian kada parlu visa nang terpisah (sajak tahun 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Babarapa kapal pasiar manawarakan Berlin, Jerman di brosurnya. Kaya nang Pian liati di peta Berlin, nang mana di situ kadada parak laut wan baelang ka kota kada tamasuk ungkus kapal pasiar.
hypothesis: Sabuah-sabuting kapal pesiar manunjuakan Berlin, Jerman dalam brosur.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Batulakan lawan pasawat bisa jadi pangalaman nang manakutakan gasan urang-urang sagala umur wan latar balakang, hususnya mun buhannya kada suah tarabang sabalumnya atawa suah ma’alami trauma.
hypothesis: Balas malalui pesawat kawa jadi pangalaman nang manakuti gasan urang-urang dari sagala umur wan latar belakang, apalagi amun buhannya kada pernah terbang sabalumnya atawa sudah mengalami kajadian traumatik.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Ngini lain parihal nang manyupanakan: ngini kada babeda matan katakutanan parurangan wan kada katuju lawan banda-banda lain nang kaya urang lain jua.
hypothesis: Hal ngini kada jadi malu: kada babeda lawan rasa takut wan kada suka lawan hal lain nang banyak banar urang.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Gasan babarapa, mamahami kayapa pasawat bagarak wan apa nang tajadi pas panarbangan kawa mannulungi gasan maatasi kagairan nang mana matannya kada dikatahui atawa di luar kandali.
hypothesis: Bagi babarapa urang, memahami sesuatu tentang cara bagawi pesawat wan apa nang tajadi pas bajalan kawa manolong maninggalakan rasa takuik nang didasarkan pada nang kada diketahui atawa kada kada ada kendali.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Parusahaan pangantaran dibayar bagus mun misalnya mangirimakan barang-barangnya lakas. Rancak tu, waktu penting banar gasan dukumin-dukumin bisnis, barang jualan atawa suku cadang gasan parbaikan nang mandasak.
hypothesis: Perusahaan kurir dibayar baik gasan mambawa barang lawan cepat. Seringnya, waktu sangat penting gasan mandapatakan dokumen bisnis, barang dagangan atawa suku cadang gasan perbaikan mendesak.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Di babarapa jalur, parusahaan-parusahaan nang taganal baisi pasawat buhannya saurang, tapi jadi masalah gasan jalur-jalur lainnya wan parusahaan-parusahaan nang tahalus.
hypothesis: Di babarapa rute, parusahaan ganal baisi pesawatnya sorang, tapi gasan rute lain wan parusahaan halus ada masalah.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Mun buhannya mangirimakan barang-barang pakai angkutan udara, di babarapa jalur ngini bisa mamarluakan babarapa hari gasan malalui proses bungkar muat wan bea cukai.
hypothesis: Amun barang-barangnya dikirim lawan kargo udara, di babarapa rute mungkin maambil babarapa hari gasan sampai di bawah kargo wan bea cukai.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Sabubutingnya cara gasan labih lakas mangirimnya sabagai barang nang tadaftar. Paraturan-paraturan maskapai cagar kada mambariakan buhannya gasan mangirim barang kada bapanumpang, nang mana ini tugas Pian.
hypothesis: Cara haja gasan mambaiki'akan barangnya lebih cepat adalah mambaiki'akan sabagai bagaj nang sudah dipariksa. Peraturan maskapai kada kawa mambaiki'akan bagaj tanpa panumpang, nang mana kamu masuk.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Cara nang nyaman gasan tulak bepesawat di kalas satu atawa bisnis ialah wan mambayar paling larang gasan hak istimewa (atawa, labih baik lagi, parusahaan mambayarinya gasan pian).
hypothesis: Cara nang jelas gasan manunggang kelas pertama atawa kelas bisnis adalah mambagi duit nang tebal gasan hak istimewa (atau, labih baik lagi, minta parusahaan Pian gasan malakukan itu gasan Pian).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Tapi, ngini kada murah: Aturannya Pian disuruh mambayar ampat kali lipat dari haraga normal gasan kelas bisnis, sebelas kali lipat gasan kursi kelas satu!
hypothesis: Namun, ini kada murah: sebagai aturan kasar, Anda kawa mananti gasan membayar sampai empat kali tarif ekonomi normal gasan bisnis, wan sebelas kali gasan kelas pertama!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Biasanya, kadada guna mancari putungan haraga gasan kursi bisnis atawa kalas satu matan panarbangan langsung matan A ka B.
hypothesis: Secara umum, kada ada gunanya mancari diskon gasan kursi bisnis atawa kelas satu di penerbangan langsung dari A ka B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Maskapai tahu banar bahwa ada bubuhan panumpang pasawat tatantu nang wani mambayar larang gasan hak istimiwa wan mandapatakan kacapatan, wan kanyamanan sasuai wan haraga.
hypothesis: Maskapai tahu banar bahwa ada sekelompok utama penumpang nang rela membayar dolar tinggi gasan hak istimewa gasan sampai di suatu tempat nang cepat wan nyaman, wan manukar biaya sasuai.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Ibukutanya Moldova ngitu Chişinău. Bahasa dairahnya Bahasa Romania, tapi Bahasa Rusia jua banyak dipakai.
hypothesis: Ibukota Moldova adalah Chişinău. Bahasa lokal adalah Rumania, tagal Rusia banyak dipakai.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
reference: Moldova ngitu republik bamacam-macam suku nang sudah mandarita gara-gara bahualan antar suku.
hypothesis: Moldova adalah republik multi-etnis nang telah menderita konflik etnis.

source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
reference: Pas tahun 1994, bahualan ma’arah ka tarjadinya pangakuan surang Republik Transnistria di timur Moldova, nang mana baisi pamarintahan wan mata uang sorang tapi kada diakui rasmi lawan banyak nagara angguta PBB.
hypothesis: Tahun 1994, konflik ngini manyabapakan pambentukan Republik Transnistria nang manyambat diri di Moldova timur, nang baisi pamarintah wan mata uangnya saurang, tagal kada diakui ulih nagara anggota PBB.

source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
reference: Hubungan ekunumi sudah dibantuk ba’asa antara dua daerah Moldova ngini sakalipun jua gagal dalam kasapakatan pulitiknya.
hypothesis: Hubungan ekonomi sudah diulah pulang antara dua bagian Moldova ini meskipun gagal dalam negosiasi politik.

source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
reference: Mayuritas agama di Moldova ngitu Kristen Ortodoks.
hypothesis: Agama utama di Moldova adalah Kristen Ortodoks.

source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
reference: İzmir ngitu kuta katalu pangganalnya di Turki wan pupulasi sakitar 3.7 juta ikung, palabuhan kadua pangganalnya imbah Istanbul, wan sarana transpurtasinya nang bagus.
hypothesis: İzmir adalah kota pangganalnya katigo di Turki lawan populasi sakitar 3,7 juta, palabuhan pangganalnya kadua imbah Istanbul, wan hub transportasi nang baik banar.

source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
reference: Suah kuta bahari Smyrna, wayah ngini sudah muderen, maju wan jadi pusat pardagangan haur nang baandak di taluk nang luas wan dikulilingi pagunungan.
hypothesis: Kota Smurna bahari, wayah ini jadi pusat komersial nang modern, maju, wan sibuk, nang ada di sakitar teluk ganal wan dililingi ulih gunung.

source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
reference: Jalanan nang luas, gadung nang bakaca wan pusat balanja moderen dibintiki wan atap tradisiunal ubin habang, pasar abad 18, lawan masigit wan gereja tuha, biar kota ngini labih banuansa ka Eropa Mediterania katimbang Turki tradisional.
hypothesis: Bulevard luas, bangunan nang ada di depan kaca wan pusat belanja modern diisi atap tradisional nang diukir merah, pasar abad ka-18, wan masjid lawas wan gereja, walaupun kota ini baisi suasana Eropa Mediterania labih dari Turki tradisional.

source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
reference: Kampung Haldarsvik manawari pamandangan pulau Eysturoy nang parak wan baisi garija basegi lapan nang kada biasa.
hypothesis: Desa Haldarsvík baisi pandangan ka pulau Eysturoy nang parak wan baisi gereja segitiga nang kada biasa.

source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
reference: Di halaman garijanya, ada patung marmer babantuk burung marpati di atas sapalihan kuburan.
hypothesis: Di kuburan, ada patung marmer nang menarik dari merpati di atas beberapa makam.

source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
reference: Parlu waktu satangah jam gasan bajalanan ka desa nang mamikat ngini.
hypothesis: Itu patut setengah jam gasan bajalan di kampung nang menarik.

source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
reference: Ka arah utara wan parak dari sana ada kuta Sintra nang romantis lawan mamikat, lawan jua jadi takenal gasan urang asing imbah kemegahannya nang bagus ditulisakan uleh Tuan Byron.
hypothesis: Di utara wan di jarak mudah adalah kota romantis wan menarik Sintra nang manjadi terkenal lawan urang asing imbah kisah nang tarang tentang kemulanya nang direkam oleh Lord Byron.

source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
reference: Bis Scotturb 403 rancak tulak ke Sintra, lalu bamandak di Cabo da Roca.
hypothesis: Bus Scotturb 403 bamacam-macam bajalanan ka Sintra, bamain di Cabo da Roca.

source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
reference: Ka utara jua maelangi Kuburan Nyunya Kita Fatima nang migah (kuil), sabuting wadah nang dikanal saluruh dunia, Maria menampaiakan diri.
hypothesis: Di utara jua bajalanan ka Sanctuary Agung Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), wadah penampakan Marian nang terkenal di saluruh dunia.

source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
reference: Tulung diingati lagi lamun Pian ni lagi maelangi wadah pakuburan massal, wan ka wadah nang baarti banar gasan sapalihan warga dunia.
hypothesis: Silakan ingat bahwa Pian basintasi manamuakan sabuah wadah makam massal, serta wadah nang baisi arti nang hampir kada kawa dihitung gasan sebagian besar populasi dunia.

source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
reference: Masih banyak banar lakian wan binian nang masih hidup salamat waktu buhannya di sini, wan banyak lagi urang nang dicintainya dibunuh atawa bagawi sampai mati di sana, urang Yahudi atawa nang lain Yahudi sama ja.
hypothesis: Masih banyak laki-laki wan bini nang hidup nang sudah hidup di sini, wan banyak lagi nang baisi urang nang dikasihi nang dibunuh atawa digawi mati di sana, Yahudi wan non-Yahudi.

source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
reference: Tulung haragu wadah ngini wan kamuliaan, khidmat, wan hormati bujur-bujur. Jangan bahuhulutan sual Holocaust atawa Nazi.
hypothesis: Silakan balakukan situs ngini dengan martabat, kesabaran wan hormat nang layaknya.

source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
reference: Jangan mancureti wadahnya lawan manciri’i atawa mancoret-coret graffiti di dalam strukturnya.
hypothesis: Kada manjahatakan situs lawan manandai atawa manakar grafiti ka struktur.

source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
reference: Bahasa rasmi Barcelona ngitu Katalan wan Spanyul. Handak sapalihan mamilih bapander bahasa Katalan, tapi kabanyakan masih paham ja, wan sabujurnya urang tahu ja bahasa Spanyul.
hypothesis: Bahasa rasmi Barcelona adalah Catalan wan Spanyol. Kira-kira satangah labih bapandir bahasa Catalan, mayoritas nang paham, wan hampir sabarataan tahu bahasa Spanyol.

source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
reference: Katia, kebanyakan cirinya manunjukakan baya di Katalan ja sabab dirasmiakan uleh hukum gasan bahasa rasmi partamanya.
hypothesis: Namun, kabanyakan tanda-tanda ditunjuk hanya dalam bahasa Katalan karena itu ditantuakan ulih hukum sabagai bahasa resmi partama.

source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
reference: Makanya, bahasa Spanyul kabanyakan jua dipakai luas di transpurtasi umum wan fasilitas lainnya.
hypothesis: Tapi, bahasa Spanyol jua banyak dipakai dalam transportasi umum wan fasilitas lain.

source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
reference: Habar nang rancak di Metro diulah baya pakai bahasa Katalan ja, tapi habar gangguan dihabarakannya pakai sistim utumatis dalam bamacam-macam bahasa nang kaya bahasa Spanyul, bahasa Inggris, bahasa Perancis, bahasa Arab, wan bahasa Japang.
hypothesis: Pengumuman reguler di Metro hanya diulah dalam bahasa Katalan, tapi gangguan nang kada di rancang diumumkan oleh sistem otomatis dalam berbagai bahasa termasuk Spanyol, Inggris, Perancis, Arab, wan Jepang.

source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
reference: Urang Paris baisi reputasi jadi urang nang mamantingakan diri saurang, kasar, wan cakah.
hypothesis: Urang Paris baisi reputasi gasan egocentric, kasar wan sombong.

source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
reference: Biar ngini tu rancak babaya ungkapan nang kada pas, cara bagus gasan bagaul di Paris tu matan bakalakuan bujur-bujur ja, bakalakuan nang kaya urang nang "bien élevé" (dilajari ba’adab). Ini cagar nang maolah tanyaman.
hypothesis: Walaupun ngini rancak hanya stereotip nang kada akurat, cara paling baik gasan basarakan diri di Paris masih adalah dengan tingkah laku nang paling baik, bafungsi sabagai urang nang "bien élevé" (dipadati baik).

source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
reference: Sifat kasar bawaan Urang Paris cagar lakas mahilang lamun Pian kawa manunjukakan babarapa adab dasar.
hypothesis: Eksterior Paris akan cepat menguap jika kamu memperlihatkan beberapa kehormatan dasar.

source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
reference: Taman Nasional Danau Plitvice hibak lawan hutan, kabanyakan lawan puhun beech, cemara, wan puhun fir, lawan manciriakan bauran tanaman pagunungan Alpen wan Mediterania.
hypothesis: Taman nasional Tasik Plitvice banyak hutan, terutama lawan kayu buaya, kayu sawit, wan kayu sawit, wan baisi campuran vegetasi Alpine wan Mediterania.

source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
reference: Ngini tu tarkanal luas bamacam-macam kalumpuk tanamannya, Disababakan jarak iklim halusnya, malainakan tanahnya, wan bamacam-macam tingkat katinggian.
